store_data.about_the_game:
Every Second Feels Like a Day; Every Decision Means Life or Death

In The Plus One Kingdom, you are the ruler of a fragile, crumbling domain. Time is relentless—1 real-world second equals 1 in-game day. Seasons change every 90 seconds. Winter is approaching, and if you’re unprepared, everyone will perish.

Survival Against All Odds

Your people need food, wood, and shelter—but there are never enough hands to do the work. Should you send workers to the fields or reinforce the walls? Every idle citizen is wasted potential, and every misstep in resource allocation could be fatal.

  • Seasonal Challenges — In spring, monsters multiply rapidly; summer brings deadly plagues; autumn demands frantic food storage; and winter drastically reduces food production. Fail to prepare, and watch your kingdom starve.

  • Precision Workforce Management — Assign your population in real-time to any of 43 professions: farmers, lumberjacks, miners, militia, scholars, priests, blacksmiths... every role is vital, and hands are always scarce.

Construction and Research

Start from a humble village and evolve into a formidable capital. As you unlock buildings and technologies, your territory undergoes eight distinct visual transformations.

  • 80+ Building Types — From granaries and barracks to arcane towers and alchemy workshops. Each structure unlocks new jobs, raises resource capacity, and strengthens defenses.

  • 80+ Technologies — Spanning gathering, military, arcane, and knowledge branches. Unlock production boosts, new buildings, and game-changing abilities.

  • Progressive Discovery — Content isn’t all unlocked at once. New buildings, technologies, and professions become available as you meet prerequisites, offering a genuine sense of exploration.

Defending Against Monster Hordes

The threat level rises daily. When it hits 100%, a massive monster army will attack your domain. You’d better be ready.

  • Tactical Group Combat — Six unit types with intricate rock-paper-scissors dynamics. Archers, militia, and mages face off against monsters in strategic, automatically resolved battles.

  • 10+ Active and Passive Skills — Status effects, auras, damage over time, healing, and cooldown management. Your specialists gain experience and level up through combat.

  • Combat Consumables — Craft healing potions in the alchemy workshop to take into battle. Use them wisely—defeat means total loss.

World Exploration

Send teams of trained fighters deep into procedurally generated wilderness maps.

  • Procedural World Map — 15 to 25 interlinked regions with graded difficulty. Every playthrough feels unique.

  • Real-Time Exploration — Teams consume food, encounter monsters, find treasures, and face dangers. Hunger is a serious threat.

  • Risk and Reward — Venturing deeper yields rarer loot, but retreat costs progress. Total party wipe results in losing all carried items.

Ancient Gods

Uncover four ancient gods lurking in the world’s depths. Collect legendary shards, perform purification rituals, and confront multi-phase boss battles featuring accumulating health pools and devastating special abilities.

Game Highlights

  • Intense Time Pressure — 1 second equals 1 day; 6 minutes equals 1 year. Time never pauses automatically.

  • 40+ Resource Types — Across 5 crafting tiers (from Primitive to Legendary).

  • 20+ Guild Quests — With outcomes based on probability.

  • 80+ Buildings — From granaries and barracks to arcane towers and alchemy workshops, each unlocking professions, expanding capacity, and strengthening defenses.

store_data.detailed_description:
Every Second Feels Like a Day; Every Decision Means Life or Death

In The Plus One Kingdom, you are the ruler of a fragile, crumbling domain. Time is relentless—1 real-world second equals 1 in-game day. Seasons change every 90 seconds. Winter is approaching, and if you’re unprepared, everyone will perish.

Survival Against All Odds

Your people need food, wood, and shelter—but there are never enough hands to do the work. Should you send workers to the fields or reinforce the walls? Every idle citizen is wasted potential, and every misstep in resource allocation could be fatal.

  • Seasonal Challenges — In spring, monsters multiply rapidly; summer brings deadly plagues; autumn demands frantic food storage; and winter drastically reduces food production. Fail to prepare, and watch your kingdom starve.

  • Precision Workforce Management — Assign your population in real-time to any of 43 professions: farmers, lumberjacks, miners, militia, scholars, priests, blacksmiths... every role is vital, and hands are always scarce.

Construction and Research

Start from a humble village and evolve into a formidable capital. As you unlock buildings and technologies, your territory undergoes eight distinct visual transformations.

  • 80+ Building Types — From granaries and barracks to arcane towers and alchemy workshops. Each structure unlocks new jobs, raises resource capacity, and strengthens defenses.

  • 80+ Technologies — Spanning gathering, military, arcane, and knowledge branches. Unlock production boosts, new buildings, and game-changing abilities.

  • Progressive Discovery — Content isn’t all unlocked at once. New buildings, technologies, and professions become available as you meet prerequisites, offering a genuine sense of exploration.

Defending Against Monster Hordes

The threat level rises daily. When it hits 100%, a massive monster army will attack your domain. You’d better be ready.

  • Tactical Group Combat — Six unit types with intricate rock-paper-scissors dynamics. Archers, militia, and mages face off against monsters in strategic, automatically resolved battles.

  • 10+ Active and Passive Skills — Status effects, auras, damage over time, healing, and cooldown management. Your specialists gain experience and level up through combat.

  • Combat Consumables — Craft healing potions in the alchemy workshop to take into battle. Use them wisely—defeat means total loss.

World Exploration

Send teams of trained fighters deep into procedurally generated wilderness maps.

  • Procedural World Map — 15 to 25 interlinked regions with graded difficulty. Every playthrough feels unique.

  • Real-Time Exploration — Teams consume food, encounter monsters, find treasures, and face dangers. Hunger is a serious threat.

  • Risk and Reward — Venturing deeper yields rarer loot, but retreat costs progress. Total party wipe results in losing all carried items.

Ancient Gods

Uncover four ancient gods lurking in the world’s depths. Collect legendary shards, perform purification rituals, and confront multi-phase boss battles featuring accumulating health pools and devastating special abilities.

Game Highlights

  • Intense Time Pressure — 1 second equals 1 day; 6 minutes equals 1 year. Time never pauses automatically.

  • 40+ Resource Types — Across 5 crafting tiers (from Primitive to Legendary).

  • 20+ Guild Quests — With outcomes based on probability.

  • 80+ Buildings — From granaries and barracks to arcane towers and alchemy workshops, each unlocking professions, expanding capacity, and strengthening defenses.

  • 80+ Technologies — Covering gathering, military, arcane, and knowledge branches; unlocking bonuses, buildings, and powerful abilities.

  • 40+ Professions — From basic farmers and lumberjacks to specialists like blacksmiths, mages, and priests, each with unique skills.

  • Multiple Save Slots and Auto-Save Support — Manage your progress with ease.

Get ready for an incredible journey of mental challenges! Embark on this adventure to solve 20 Sokoban-style puzzles. You will take control of a skilled worker who needs to push the boxes to their proper places. With skill and strategy, you will overcome each challenge and become a master in this captivating game. Ready to start?

He looked at some crates huddled in the corner. If he pushed the middle one against the wall, he would be trapped. A single mistake, a solitary lapse in spatial judgment, and the path would be blocked forever.

If this is a dream, why is it so relentlessly logical? Dreams are supposed to be fluid, shifting like watercolor under rain.

If this is reality, why is it so empty? There is no hunger here, only the phantom itch of a puzzle needing to be solved.

store_data.about_the_game:
Grab your mower, call your friends, and turn chaos into a perfectly trimmed lawn!
Mow Simulator Together is a fast-paced co-op multiplayer game for up to 4 players, where teamwork, rivalry, and smart decisions decide who becomes the ultimate lawn master. 🌿🚜

🌱 Cut, Compete, and Outsmart

Spawn in different areas and race toward grass zones that need to be cleared. Each session drops players into unique maps filled with opportunities to score points. Reaching them is part of the challenge. Choose your route carefully, move fast, and outplay your friends by mowing more grass before time runs out.

🚜 Choose Your Mower

Pick from different mowers, each with its own strengths. Some are faster, others are more stable or durable. The right choice can give you a strong advantage, but only if you know how to use it.

🔥 Manage Your Machine

Your mower reacts to how you play. Push too hard and the engine can overheat. Hit obstacles and your blade may lose efficiency. Collisions and rough driving can damage your machine, forcing you to adapt quickly during the match.

🛠 Limited Repairs

You can only carry one repair tool at a time, which means every decision matters. Fix your engine, repair your blade, or restore your mower body depending on the situation. Choosing the wrong moment can cost you the match.

😈 Friends or Rivals

Work together or turn against each other. Block paths, crash into opponents, and create chaos to gain an advantage. But every action has consequences, and your friends can always fight back.

🌍 Dynamic Matches

Each session offers different layouts and mowing zones, creating variety and replayability. No match plays the same, and every round brings new strategies and unexpected moments.

Only one player can come out on top. Will you play fair, or do whatever it takes to win?

Worldview Introduction

Past Westward Journey-themed games are mostly confined to the worldview framework of "gods, demons and chaotic battles", simplifying the journey to the West into a series of exhilarating showdowns of slaying demons and subduing monsters. Yet they overlook the ultimate true meaning of Journey to the West written by Wu Cheng’en — the westward journey is never an outward conquest, but an inward self‑questioning. Dispelling misfortunes is never an achievement of exterminating external demons, but a spiritual practice of overcoming inner obsessions.

Gameplay Introduction

Game Genre: Single-player Turn-based Tactical RPG

Basic Operation Logic:

Square grid map, each unit occupies one grid.

Turn‑based alternating actions: All player units act → All enemy units act.

Each unit per turn: Move (consume movement points) + Action (Attack / Skill / Item / Standby), either chosen individually or combined.

Operations: Select a unit → Blue highlighted movable grids → Target grid → Choose Attack / Skill / Item → Select target → Execute.

Core Protagonist Mechanic: Level failure if the protagonist perishes.

Worldview Introduction

Past Westward Journey-themed games are mostly confined to the worldview framework of "gods, demons and chaotic battles", simplifying the journey to the West into a series of exhilarating showdowns of slaying demons and subduing monsters. Yet they overlook the ultimate true meaning of Journey to the West written by Wu Cheng’en — the westward journey is never an outward conquest, but an inward self‑questioning. Dispelling misfortunes is never an achievement of exterminating external demons, but a spiritual practice of overcoming inner obsessions.

Gameplay Introduction

Game Genre: Single-player Turn-based Tactical RPG

Basic Operation Logic:

Square grid map, each unit occupies one grid.

Turn‑based alternating actions: All player units act → All enemy units act.

Each unit per turn: Move (consume movement points) + Action (Attack / Skill / Item / Standby), either chosen individually or combined.

Operations: Select a unit → Blue highlighted movable grids → Target grid → Choose Attack / Skill / Item → Select target → Execute.

Core Protagonist Mechanic: Level failure if the protagonist perishes.

store_data.about_the_game:
Skate Rush: 90s Retro Arcade is a fast, colorful arcade skating game inspired by the energy of classic 90s games.

Jump into quick runs, dodge obstacles, keep your speed, and chase a better score every time you play. With real life TRICKS. It is built for short, replayable sessions where timing, rhythm, and clean reactions matter more than complicated controls.

Features

- Fast arcade skating action

- Simple controls and quick restarts

- Retro-inspired 90s presentation

- Score-focused gameplay

- Obstacles, jumps, and tight timing

- Single-player runs built for replayability

- Lightweight free-to-play experience

Skate Rush is easy to start, but each run pushes you to react faster, survive longer, and beat your best score.

store_data.about_the_game:
【Prologue】

'Blooming Canvas' is a visual novel about painting, and also Pygma's new exploration of "creation." In this hurried world, may everyone rediscover the purity of creation, the emotion stirred by beauty, and the longing for love. We hope this work brings a positive and uplifting feeling to all.

【Story Synopsis】

Ji Xingyu, a painter who achieved fame at a young age, once fell into a long, gray-white dream.

When he woke from the dream, he found he could no longer retrieve the liveliness that had vanished from his brush.

Now, having shed the halo of a prodigy, he lives as an ordinary painter after graduation, making a living through his art.

Day after day, staying up late to meet deadlines, he gradually grows accustomed to a busy yet quiet life.

— Until that summer.

A mysterious blonde girl visits him, bringing with her a damaged masterpiece…

As the Flower and Bird Festival art exhibition draws near, the past and the truth buried deep within the strokes of his brush will slowly come to light.

【Charactors】

  • All characters in the game are adults over the age of 18.

  • 枫丹水梦（Shuimeng Fontaine)

A foreign girl who stumbles into the studio by chance, possessing an extraordinary passion for painting.

As Xingyu's student and assistant, she stays in the studio to practice, awaiting the opening of the Flower and Bird Festival exhibition.

Hoping to fulfill a promise made to someone, she dreams of painting the most perfect sunflower the world has ever seen.

  • 苏绫菲 (Su lingfei)

By day, she's a maid playing the role of the little devil "Mephis" at a café, and also a trustworthy underclassman.

She once signed a strange contract with Xingyu and often looks after him under the pretense of fulfilling its terms. Coming from a well-known artistic family in the local city of Funiao, she gave up painting due to a lack of talent and has since returned to an ordinary life.

  • 芙洛·古根海姆 (Flora Guggenheim)

A mysterious blonde girl Xingyu encounters by chance in the garden. Elegant in speech, she carries a surprising sense of trustworthiness.

She is a patron of the renowned artist collective "The Order of the Golden Knights" and an exceptional art collector. She brings a severely damaged precious painting and commissions Xingyu with an almost impossible restoration task.

  • 季星雨 (Ji xingyu)

The male protagonist of this story.A highly skilled yet unpopular painter.

He recently purchased a second-hand studio from a senior who had switched careers and began living a life of painting with reversed day and night.

Once a rising star highly anticipated by the industry, he has since unfortunately fallen from grace.

【Game Features】

  • Dual-playthrough storytelling – uncover the truth through two completely different storylines.

  • Build emotional connections with the heroines, creating an immersive romantic experience.

  • Unique art style and atmospheric music offer a distinctive audiovisual experience.

  • More than just romance – also includes a touch of philosophical reflection on art and aesthetics.

【Closing Remarks】

You can join the player group (1082329086) or follow "Pygma山鬼工坊" on Bilibili.

If you like the game, please consider adding it to your wishlist to support us. That means a lot to us. Thank you for your support!

A foreign girl who stumbles into the studio by chance, possessing an extraordinary passion for painting.

As Xingyu's student and assistant, she stays in the studio to practice, awaiting the opening of the Flower and Bird Festival exhibition.

Hoping to fulfill a promise made to someone, she dreams of painting the most perfect sunflower the world has ever seen.

  • 苏绫菲 (Su lingfei)

By day, she's a maid playing the role of the little devil "Mephis" at a café, and also a trustworthy underclassman.

She once signed a strange contract with Xingyu and often looks after him under the pretense of fulfilling its terms. Coming from a well-known artistic family in the local city of Funiao, she gave up painting due to a lack of talent and has since returned to an ordinary life.

  • 芙洛·古根海姆 (Flora Guggenheim)

A mysterious blonde girl Xingyu encounters by chance in the garden. Elegant in speech, she carries a surprising sense of trustworthiness.

She is a patron of the renowned artist collective "The Order of the Golden Knights" and an exceptional art collector. She brings a severely damaged precious painting and commissions Xingyu with an almost impossible restoration task.

  • 季星雨 (Ji xingyu)

The male protagonist of this story.A highly skilled yet unpopular painter.

He recently purchased a second-hand studio from a senior who had switched careers and began living a life of painting with reversed day and night.

Once a rising star highly anticipated by the industry, he has since unfortunately fallen from grace.

【Game Features】

  • Dual-playthrough storytelling – uncover the truth through two completely different storylines.

  • Build emotional connections with the heroines, creating an immersive romantic experience.

  • Unique art style and atmospheric music offer a distinctive audiovisual experience.

  • More than just romance – also includes a touch of philosophical reflection on art and aesthetics.

【Closing Remarks】

You can join the player group (1082329086) or follow "Pygma山鬼工坊" on Bilibili.

If you like the game, please consider adding it to your wishlist to support us. That means a lot to us. Thank you for your support!

store_data.about_the_game:
DarkCage is a mystery escape-room adventure where you must solve puzzles and gather clues alongside others trapped in an unfamiliar place. Only by uncovering the truth can you hope to escape.

Synopsis

"Where... am I?"

You awaken to find yourself imprisoned in an unknown space. Around you are others—strangers, yet clearly sharing the same fate.

To escape, you must solve puzzles and collect clues. But mere problem-solving will not be enough. You must piece together what you find, deduce the situation, and uncover the hidden truth. Only then will a way out reveal itself.

Will you make it out of this place alive...?

Key Features

  • Escape Room–Inspired Puzzle Design
    Built upon the structure of real-world escape room experiences, the game offers immersive and intuitive puzzles. Its carefully layered design allows players to progress naturally, one step at a time.

  • Integrated Hint System
    Even when you find yourself stuck, the journey doesn't have to end. A built-in system allows the protagonist to assist with puzzle-solving, offering optional guidance so you can continue without breaking immersion.

  • A Fusion of Puzzles and Deduction
    This is more than just solving puzzles. You must analyze the clues you gather, interpret the situation, and draw your own conclusions. Only sound judgment will lead you to the end of the story.

  • Branching Failures Based on Choice
    Your decisions shape the course of the game. Wrong choices may lead to unexpected consequences, and every judgment you make could determine whether—or how—you escape.

store_data.about_the_game:
You signed the deal...

Now the table is waiting...

A minimalist, atmospheric roguelike where every decision is a trade-off between power and pain.

You don’t just play cards — you pay for them.

CORE GAMEPLAY

  • Play cards onto the table to deal damage

  • Every move can hurt you back

  • Manage Blood Force, self damage, and limited moves

  • Survive against increasingly hostile entities

This is not about luck.

This is about how far you’re willing to go.

BUILD YOUR RUN

  • Collect powerful Relics between circles

  • Accept or reject Omens during battle

  • Modify your deck with:

  • Bloodmarked Cards (double damage)

  • Scars / Sigils that change behavior

Create broken combinations… or die trying.

FACE THE MONSTERS

Each entity bends the rules:

  • The Witness — it sees everything

  • The Bone Dealer — it trades your loss

  • The Many — it overwhelms

  • The Architect — it controls the system

  • The Infestation — it spreads

They don’t just fight you.

They change the game itself.

15 RITUAL CIRCLES

Progress deeper into the deal:

  • Each circle introduces new mechanics

  • New relics and omens become possible

  • The pressure grows

You are not meant to reach the end.

FEATURES

  • Dark, minimal horror atmosphere

  • Deep risk/reward gameplay

  • Multiple build archetypes

  • High replayability

  • Cryptic narrative that unfolds as you play

The deal does not end.

It deepens.

It started with a burning hot dog stand. Now the whole city won't stop calling you. You're not a firefighter. You're not trained. But somehow… you're the only one showing up.

Put out fires. Stop gas leaks. Smash through smoke-filled apartments. Handle bizarre accidents, exploding equipment, and chaotic emergencies that spiral out of control in seconds. Every call is unpredictable. Every second counts.

Move fast. Think faster. Improvise everything. Explore a living, breathing open city where anything can go wrong at any moment. Race to emergencies on foot or jump into vehicles and get there before it's too late. The more jobs you take, the better your gear gets. But the city keeps getting worse.

Something strange is happening. Incidents are escalating. Patterns are forming. You're not here to investigate. You're here to save whoever you can.

• Open city sandbox - go anywhere, respond to anything

• Unpredictable emergencies - no two missions play the same

• Fast, chaotic gameplay - act now, figure it out on the fly

• Upgrade your gear - become faster, stronger, better equipped

• Drive multiple vehicles - reach disasters before they escalate

• Dynamic call system - the city constantly throws new problems at you

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Happy Country.
The happiest country in the world… they said.

Step into the worn-out shoes of an ordinary person trying to survive life in 1990s recession-era Finland. In Happy Country, the postcard image of happiness slowly cracks, revealing the cold winds, empty wallets, and tough choices.

Happy Country is a first-person life simulation set in a fully 3D world where survival isn't just about staying alive, but about staying afloat.

Explore a wide and living environment inspired by rural and urban Finland of the 1990s. Take on jobs, complete tasks, manage your hunger, health, and money, and make choices that shape your journey. Whether you're scraping together coins for food, fixing problems, avoiding dangers, or simply trying to get through another grey morning, every decision matters.

Experience Finland as it truly feels:
long winters, unpredictable weather, quiet forests, stubborn machinery, and a culture that rewards resilience… and occasionally strong coffee.

Features

  • Live Your Own Story
    No single path. Solve problems your way, make choices that affect your survival, and shape your own journey through hardship and hope.

  • Deep Survival Simulation
    Monitor vital needs like hunger, health, and money. Life isn't cheap, and neither are mistakes.

  • A Unique Setting
    Experience the rarely explored world of 1990s Finland during the economic recession, blending realism with dark humor and cultural authenticity.

  • Large Open Areas to Explore
    Travel across varied locations, complete missions, discover secrets, and learn how to survive in an unforgiving environment. Listen to the game's 16 different radio channels.

  • Dynamic Finnish Atmosphere
    Face changing weather, time-based clock system and the everyday realities of Finnish life such as power outages and other bigger problems.

  • Authentic Language Experience
    English subtitles guide the story, while Finnish voice acting delivers an authentic and immersive cultural experience.

store_data.about_the_game:
Engage enemy fleets in this tactical space RPG where every decision matters. Battles take place on an 8 X 5 grid with each team locked to their half of the battlefield. Each battle is a test of planning and execution. Victory requires managing a fleet that can defeat your enemies through upgrades, equipment, and supplies. You will be given all the tools and information required to prepare your fleet for the next battle.

Gameplay

Each character has a base unit type: Attacker, Sniper, Warship, Medic, etc. As you progress through the campaign, you choose what attacks and abilities each unit has, how each unit is able to move, and ultimately how your fleet operates. Whether your ships are armed with overwhelming firepower, impenetrable defense, or a focus on a balance, you have complete control on how you upgrade and manage your fleet.

Attacks are position-based and require two resources: Energy and Charge. Certain abilities feature unique attack ranges capable of striking multiple enemies at once. You must decide if using the extra resources are worth the extra firepower.

Story

The story of this game deals with an unknown enemy manipulating human events in order to gain control. As the conflict unfolds, what everyone assumed to be true about the enemy begins to change. Allies begin to question allegiance, unfamiliar technology destroys the beliefs that everybody assumed to be true, and motives no longer make sense. What once appeared to be random attacks by pirates are revealed to be a calculated and long term plan...

Each decision improves your efficiency, and every layer of growth feeds into the next, creating the rewarding loop that makes incremental games so compelling.

  • Incremental progression with a strong sense of momentum

  • Post-battle upgrades that keep every run meaningful

  • Multiple growth paths through skill trees, shops, and relics

  • Easy to enjoy casually, with plenty of room for optimization

Watch a small, adorable hero grow into a force capable of conquering an ever-expanding battlefield.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the world of MUSO.

Five misfits find their way through fate and overcome a bad hand of cards dealt to them - and despite their flaws - ensure that they're always right behind one another, having each others backs no matter what!

In this game, you'll experience all kinds of stuff.

What does this game feature?

MUSO features...

  • A rhythm-based battle system, where you can land up to 16 total hits on an enemy!

  • A side-rolling HP meter that allows you to save yourself in battle before it's too late!

  • Short, witty, dad joke-esque humor that is guaranteed to make you hang your head in shame.

  • Five total party members! (Yeah, that's five total HP meters to keep track of...)

  • 8 total chapters, alongside a Prologue and an Epilogue. (Basically 10 Chapters.)

  • Heart-felt moments guaranteed to make you think twice on all of your decisions leading up to them.

  • Environments inspired by the late 1960's America. 

  • One ending, but it's about the journey anyways - not the destination.

  • Pixel-art environments and characters reminiscent of older games designed with both modern monitors and CRT displays in-mind. 

  • One wacky soundtrack made entirely by the director and lead of the project!

So, what else?

MUSO has a story, and it's waiting for you to listen to it.

With the kindness of my heart, I welcome you to the world of MUSO.

  • A side-rolling HP meter that allows you to save yourself in battle before it's too late!

  • Short, witty, dad joke-esque humor that is guaranteed to make you hang your head in shame.

  • Five total party members! (Yeah, that's five total HP meters to keep track of...)

  • 8 total chapters, alongside a Prologue and an Epilogue. (Basically 10 Chapters.)

  • Heart-felt moments guaranteed to make you think twice on all of your decisions leading up to them.

  • Environments inspired by the late 1960's America. 

  • One ending, but it's about the journey anyways - not the destination.

  • Pixel-art environments and characters reminiscent of older games designed with both modern monitors and CRT displays in-mind. 

  • One wacky soundtrack made entirely by the director and lead of the project!

So, what else?

MUSO has a story, and it's waiting for you to listen to it.

With the kindness of my heart, I welcome you to the world of MUSO.
store_data.short_description: A ragtag, misfit group of five band together, defying fate and work to solve their world's many mysteries. Explore strange worlds! Meet colorful friends! Fight wacky foes! Near the end...you'll be met with the final question: Which side prevails? Hope, or despair...? Welcome to the World of MUSO.

store_data.about_the_game:
Granby, Colorado. 2003.

The dozer didn't sell at auction. Nobody wanted it. Now it sits in your workshop. You have a grudge, a welding torch, and thirty-five thousand dollars.

PHASE 1 — THE WORKSHOP

A man alone in a garage at 2am.

Spend on armor, engine, cooling, treads, cameras. Every upgrade draws suspicion. Every day costs cash. The neighbor peers over the fence. The hardware clerk asks too many questions. An inspector heard the welding. A reporter's been asking about your zoning dispute.

You cannot afford everything. Every run is a conversation about what to sacrifice.

PHASE 2 — THE RECKONING

Drive. Destroy. Survive.

Six priority targets. One machine. Six thousand kilograms of concrete and steel on tank treads. Ram buildings at speed — heavier armor and stronger engines turn walls into dust. Heat builds as you demolish. Overheat, and the engine stalls for three long seconds while the sirens close in.

Every choice you made in the workshop plays out here. The cooling you skipped. The cameras you couldn't afford. The armor that's keeping you alive.

FEATURES

  • 30–45 minute complete runs — built for a single evening

  • Five upgrade paths that reshape how the rampage plays

  • Twelve branching workshop events with real consequences

  • Force-based destruction physics — mass and momentum matter

  • Escalating police response across five wanted levels

  • Original soundtrack with adaptive music across three phases

  • Save anytime, resume mid-workshop

A NOTE ON THE SOURCE

This game is a work of fiction inspired by a real event. On June 4, 2004, Marvin Heemeyer drove a modified Komatsu D355A through Granby, Colorado. No one else was killed. The grievances, the machine, and the man were real.

Project Haymaker is not about celebrating what he did. It's about understanding how someone gets there — and handing the wrench to the player.

"Sometimes reasonable men must do unreasonable things."

When the greatest detective in the tropics is dead, who can solve the mystery of his death? Play as Helen, Patrício Jânio's maid, the prime suspect in her boss's murder. Race against time, prove your innocence while escaping the spotlight and mysteries of your own past.

Do you trust your memory and deductive skills? Don't rely on the game to remind you of the details; write everything down, be suspicious of everyone, and investigate every corner of the city of São Paolo.

Talk to my lawyer! With the help of João, Jânio's former lawyer, gain access to restricted areas and use your smooth talk to obtain information and gossip. Don't let anything slip by!

The secrets of the city's most famous detective's past return to haunt those who remain. Call it fate or karma, but a story left unfinished always returns for a—in my view—cinematic ending!

Game characters come in all shapes and sizes. They can be brave knights, brilliant scientists, or superheroes who save entire worlds. This game offers a more unusual experience. Here you can become a starfish. Yes, that's right. You're an ordinary starfish, and your only purpose in this world is simply to exist. No challenges, no rush, no worries, no responsibilities. Nothing is required of you; simply enjoy the singing of birds and the sound of the wind. You can comfortably lounge on the warm sand of a sunny beach or deep beneath the sea, or in other rather strange and even illogical places. Become the best starfish you can be.

 

In terms of gameplay, this is a meditative game about contemplating a starfish against a backdrop of beautiful landscapes. From the menu, you can choose one of the starfish, as well as the location that suits you best: a tropical beach, a desert, the ocean floor, space, or a futuristic city street.

 

Features

- Dynamic gameplay

- Birdsong and beautiful landscapes

- Choose from 18 levels and 36 starfish

store_data.about_the_game:
Create Your Alien!

Weapons, armor, and origins can be mixed and matched to create a wide range of playstyles. An assortment of customization options exists including heads, suits, weapon variations, and color schemes.  Origins determine the abilities an alien has and also changes the effects and color of the selected weapon.

Stats As Loot!

Loot comes in the form of crystals for each stat.  If an item or ability has a stat, a crystal that contains the same stat can be used to improve it.  To use a crystal, players simply need infusion essence that drops from enemies and as rewards for completing objectives.  Rare loot comes in the form of legendary crystals that have various uses such as increasing rarity or allowing items and abilities to be reset back to their original state.  Unneeded crystals can be salvaged for extra infusion essence.

Levels and Scaling

Invasion level is raised by completing objectives.  The world map, all objectives, and areas to explore are randomly generated so the world is everchanging.  As invasion level goes up, more difficult areas will appear on the map and enemies will become stronger.  This rise in difficulty also comes with better chances at finding rare crystals!  Being defeated will result in lowering the invasion level and being sent back to the ship.

Features

  • Create bizarre alien builds with mix-and-match weapons, armor, and origins.

  • Customize your alien with unique heads, suits, weapon variants, and color schemes.

  • Smash, launch, grab, and throw enemies into each other.

  • Unleash destructive alien powers across chaotic battlefields.

  • Explore procedurally generated areas filled with randomized objectives and encounters.

  • Collect crystal-based loot that directly upgrades your stats, gear, and abilities.

  • Use legendary crystals to reroll, reset, and enhance powerful equipment.

  • Salvage unwanted crystals for infusion essence used in upgrading builds.

  • Raise invasion level to unlock harder areas, tougher enemies, and rarer rewards.

  • Enjoy streamlined auto-pickup loot without inventory clutter or micromanagement.

store_data.about_the_game:
We Die Below

We Die Below is a brutal co-op dungeon crawler for 1–4 players. Select your class, manage your kit, and descend into shifting hellscapes where the environment is as hostile as the things living in it. Every objective is a gamble, and the exit is never a given.

The Pressure Increases

The deeper you go, the more the world reacts. Enemies become faster and more aggressive the longer you linger, turning your extraction into a desperate gauntlet. In these depths, the most dangerous moment of the mission is often the walk back to the door.

Refine Your Kit

Survival earns you more than just a reprieve; it unlocks the tools you need to go deeper next time.

  • Modular Progression: Unlock new gear and abilities to solve specific tactical problems.

  • Adapt or Die: Experiment with varied loadouts to counter new threats, or specialize in a "signature build" and see how much punishment it can actually take.

  • No Fixed Meta: Shifting mission parameters mean the strategy that worked last time might get you killed this time.

Tactics Over Chaos

Whether you’re anchoring the frontline, managing crowd density, or capitalizing on high-value targets, every role is a load-bearing pillar of the team. When your coordination clicks, you’re a force of nature. When one person overextends, the whole run can collapse in seconds.

Shifting Hellscapes

Procedurally generated environments offer more than just different layouts; they force you to change how you move. One run might be a calculated hunt; the next might be a frantic scramble through a layout that feels designed to trap you.

High Stakes, Brutal Returns

Every mission is a series of "stay or go" decisions. Push further for better loot and risk losing everything, or extract early and live to upgrade another day. The world will eventually find a way to break your winning streak—the only question is how much you’ll claw out of the dirt before it does.

store_data.about_the_game:
Dive into a requiem for a world in its death throes.

At the heart of a collapsing world, chaos is the only certainty. As deities tear each other apart in a conflict that consumes existence itself, you move through the shadows, nameless. Your true challenge is to unravel the mystery of this decay, to understand the forces at play, and finally act accordingly to impose your will in the final moments of this moribund world.

Key Features:

  • Master Elemental Chaos: Combat is at the heart of the experience. Forget simple button mashing. Experiment with a devastating magic combo system. Combine ice and lightning for explosive reactions. Exploit your enemies' vulnerabilities. This is a battle of precision and reaction.

  • A Shattered World, Ruins to Explore: Explore an interconnected Metroidvania world, crafted with painstaking attention to detail. Discover secrets in stunning environments like the Great Library of Fallen Deities. Acquire new abilities to overcome environmental obstacles and access uncharted areas.

  • A Hand-Drawn Masterpiece: Every frame, every enemy, and every magical effect is carefully hand-drawn and animated in a unique 2D anime style. Immerse yourself in a dark, melancholic, and visually stunning atmosphere.

  • Forge Your Nameless Destiny: The gods ignore you, and you will use that to your advantage. Forge your own legend amidst the chaos. The divine conflict is an opportunity; how will you exploit it to carve your path?

store_data.about_the_game:
Chess 2 is a turn-based strategy game that combines chess with 4X systems.

You capture territory, build farms, grow your economy, spawn units, and fight for control of the map. It is not just about moving pieces well. You also need to expand, defend key areas, manage resources, and deal with diplomacy.

The game has both singleplayer and multiplayer, with matches built around map control, army management, and long-term decision making.

Alongside familiar chess units, Chess 2 also includes special pieces that change how matches play. Expect pieces like the Dragon, which copies movement patterns, the Nuke, which can blow pieces up, the Portal, which lets units teleport, and other unusual units that add new tactical options to the board.

Features

  • Chess-inspired turn-based strategy

  • Territory control and expansion

  • Economy systems, including farms

  • Unit spawning and army management

  • Diplomacy

  • Singleplayer and multiplayer

  • Special units with unique abilities

  • Multiple modes, from more controlled rulesets to chaotic ones

  • Custom maps

  • Replay and planning tools like premoves and arrows

Chess 2 is for players who like chess, strategy games, and map control, but want more than a normal match on a fixed board.

store_data.about_the_game:
Follow the rules. Survive the night.

Gaslit Bay is a co-op psychological horror game where up to players must survive a night shift at a remote gas station… by obeying strict, ever-changing rules.

What seems like a simple job like serving customers, stocking shelves and pumping gas, quickly turns into something far more disturbing that you could ever have imagined. The rules are there to protect you. Break them, and reality starts to fall apart.

The convenience store

Work the night shift in an isolated gas station surrounded by a dark, endless forest.

Handle customers, monitor cameras, restock items, keep the business running... But beware, something is watching you from the shadows.

Follow the rules.

Each shift brings a randomized set of rules you must follow.

  • Sometimes you can only answer the phone after the second ring.

  • DO NOT look at the fuel truck driver.

  • Sometimes you need to ignore the knocking from the freezer.

Be careful... If everything seems too quiet, maybe it is a good time to find some place to hide.

Every mistake invites something closer to you.

Co-op survival

Play solo or with friends and coordinate to survive.

  • Decide who is going to risk going into the dark.

  • Communicate events that are crucial for your survival (or maybe not...)

But do not forget... not everyone you see is your teammate.

The rules are there to protect you.

This gas station was never meant to stay open.

The rules aren't random, they are warnings.

store_data.about_the_game:
THE CELL MUST SURVIVE

In Project: C.E.L.L., you are a scientist running a corporate immortality experiment. As a retro-terminal sci-fi roguelike management sim, the project challenges you to build organelles, manage living systems, and keep a fragile experimental cell alive for as many years as possible.

What begins as a controlled test quickly becomes a fight against biology itself. Energy must be produced. Resources must stay balanced. Waste, pressure, acidity, ROS, and DNA damage must be contained before they spiral into catastrophic collapse. Every choice matters, every failure teaches, and every extra year brings the corporation closer to the breakthrough it wants to own.

How many years can you keep Project: C.E.L.L. alive?

RUN THE EXPERIMENT

Guide a living cell through increasingly unstable simulations, making constant decisions to expand, repair, optimize, and survive.

BUILD ORGANELLES

Develop the cell from the inside out with specialized organelles that power production, reduce danger, and unlock new strategic options.

SURVIVE THE AGING CURVE

The simulation gets harsher with every passing phase. Early runs reward growth and efficiency, but long-term survival demands adaptation and hard choices as the cell begins to break down under age and stress.

DIE, ITERATE, IMPROVE

Each failed run feeds the next. Gather research data, unlock permanent upgrades, and refine your approach across repeated experiments as you push each new cell beyond the limits of the last.

MASTER THE CORPORATION'S MOST IMPORTANT EXPERIMENT

  • Build and upgrade organelles with distinct functions and tradeoffs

  • Manage interconnected resources and prevent cascading system failures

  • Counter rising threats like acidity, pressure, waste, ROS, and DNA damage

  • Adapt to increasingly hostile late-stage survival conditions

  • Earn permanent progression between runs and develop stronger strategies over time

  • Chase longer-lived cells, cleaner runs, and better data with every attempt

The corporation is watching. Keep the cell alive. Gather the data. Chase immortality.

store_data.about_the_game:
Entiled is an infinite spatial tile clearing puzzle game with endless replayability.

Click and remove tiles from the board without colliding into others. Build your multiplier by matching the active color, trigger satisfying chain reactions with Special Tiles, and maintain your streak to maximize your score.

As puzzles grow in size and complexity, you’ll need to think ahead, preserve movement space, and adapt your strategy on the fly. One mistake can break your momentum, but smart planning can turn a single move into a massive combo.

Compete in Ranked Play through Steam Leaderboards, climbing the ranks in both High Score and Fastest Tiles Per Second (TPS) clearing across multiple puzzle size classes.

Create and share your own puzzles using the built-in Puzzle Maker. Design custom layouts with unique tile combinations, export and import puzzle files, and upload your creations directly to the Steam Workshop for the community to play.

Browse, download, and play community made puzzles from the Steam Workshop, expanding the game with endless new challenges and player-made creations.

With multiple game modes, scaling difficulty, ranked leaderboards, community puzzle sharing, and short replayable sessions, Entiled is designed to reward both quick thinking and long-term mastery.

Perfect for quick sessions or extended play, whether you’re chasing leaderboard positions, building puzzles, or just looking to unwind.
store_data.detailed_description:
Entiled is an infinite spatial tile clearing puzzle game with endless replayability.

Click and remove tiles from the board without colliding into others. Build your multiplier by matching the active color, trigger satisfying chain reactions with Special Tiles, and maintain your streak to maximize your score.

As puzzles grow in size and complexity, you’ll need to think ahead, preserve movement space, and adapt your strategy on the fly. One mistake can break your momentum, but smart planning can turn a single move into a massive combo.

Compete in Ranked Play through Steam Leaderboards, climbing the ranks in both High Score and Fastest Tiles Per Second (TPS) clearing across multiple puzzle size classes.

Create and share your own puzzles using the built-in Puzzle Maker. Design custom layouts with unique tile combinations, export and import puzzle files, and upload your creations directly to the Steam Workshop for the community to play.

Browse, download, and play community made puzzles from the Steam Workshop, expanding the game with endless new challenges and player-made creations.

With multiple game modes, scaling difficulty, ranked leaderboards, community puzzle sharing, and short replayable sessions, Entiled is designed to reward both quick thinking and long-term mastery.

Perfect for quick sessions or extended play, whether you’re chasing leaderboard positions, building puzzles, or just looking to unwind.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Haunted Spot is a 2D top-down survival horror game based on the story of a paranormal enthusiast called Jack who arrived at a century-old abandoned haunted house to experience the paranormal.

The house was built during the 1900s and located at a remote location in the US, where a family used to live. During the 1940s, some tragic incidents occurred inside the house, which marked the beginning of paranormal activities. During the 1980s, the family moved out of the house and never came back. Rumor had it that the house was built on cursed land. Even though nobody lived there for a long time, people passing by the house reported lights going off on their own, and weird growling as well as crying sounds could be heard.

There have been reports of several break-ins in the house, and the various Satanic rituals were performed there, which unleashed dark forces inside the house.

You play as Jack, a paranormal enthusiast, and your mission is to investigate the abandoned house for experiencing paranormal activities.

Are you ready to accept the challenge?

Key Features:

  • Explore the entire abandoned haunted house!
  • Different kinds of evil spirits lurking in the shadows!
  • Collect items like keys, haunted doll, etc.
  • Avoid deadly traps like big blades, fire, etc.
  • Explore the unknown spirit dimension!
  • Nearly half-an hour of paranormal investigation.

Warning:

This game contains flashing lights which may not be suitable for people with epilepsy or other photosensitive conditions. Player discretion is advised.

store_data.about_the_game:
In MYRIORAMA, players control Ou, a sort of wandering handyman, to explore a charming world inspired by classic stop-motion animation. Using versatile magic abilities, players will guide Ou across a varied landscape full of unique characters that change in significant ways according to the progression of a dynamic story about loss, hopelessness, and supporting one another in the face of despair.

This Stop-Motion World is Your Oyster

Explore every nook and cranny of a massive diorama that channels the Rankin Bass Animagic films, the works of Piotr Kamler, and animé of the 80s and 90s. Low framerate animations will create the illusion of plastic toys moving around a vast playset.

Rearrange! Rework! Reimagine!

Using a set of slick augmented reality goggles, players can rotate and rearrange dungeons rooms to solve puzzles. Each dungeon will work differently, so keep your thinking cap on!

Unlock the Power of Sight

Ou's goggles can also send Commands to swarms of nanites, granting fantastic, spell-like  abilities. Find and install Commands to—

  • light objects or enemies on fire

  • freeze objects or enemies

  • push or pull objects and enemies

  • push or pull yourself toward/away from objects and enemies

  • shine a light in the dark

  • absorb light to create a shadow to hide in

—and more!

Rich Lore & Complex Characters

Get to know a motley crew of outsiders living in a strange land. Progressing through the game to learn more about not only Ou's neighbors but the mysterious “ancients” hidden deep beneath the surface of the world. What unfathomable secrets do their arcane techno-caverns hold? How did the world Ou inhabits come to be? These questions shape the narrative of MYRIORAMA, a game that asks what happens when there is no hero to stop the sky from falling.

store_data.about_the_game:
Alone on a small vessel, you drift through a silent, fog covered ocean with no clear direction, only the instinct to keep moving forward.

To survive, you must gather what little remains. Scattered debris drifts across the water, remnants of a world long gone. Every piece matters. Every journey into the unknown is a risk.

Wreckage, ruins, and the remains of a drowned world block your path. To move forward, you must leave the safety of your vessel and step into what lies beyond the fog.

Somewhere beyond the fog, there may still be survivors.

If you can keep moving long enough to find them.

Game Features

  • Survival at Sea: Gather floating debris and manage your vessel to stay alive in an endless ocean.

  • Drowned World: Navigate through sunken towns, cities, and forests hidden within dense fog.

  • Progress-Driven Exploration: Leave your vessel to overcome obstacles and continue your journey.

  • Atmospheric Horror: Thick fog, limited visibility, and the decaying remains of a drowned world create constant unease.

  • A Distant Hope: Venture into the unknown and discover whether any survivors remain.

store_data.about_the_game:
《Dance of Y》是一款以律动、节奏与优雅交锋为主题的回合制角色扮演游戏，在经典 RPG 战斗机制中呈现流畅而富有变化的策略体验。玩家将踏上一段充满韵律感的冒险旅程，通过精准的回合操作指挥角色行动，在攻防转换之间展现属于自己的战斗节拍。

游戏采用传统回合制战斗系统，玩家需要在攻击、防御、技能释放与资源运用之间做出判断。每一回合都如同一次步伐变化，既要把握进攻时机，也要及时调整防守节奏。面对不同敌人与连续挑战，只有合理安排行动顺序并灵活应对局势变化，才能在战斗中保持主动。

随着冒险推进，角色能力将不断成长。玩家可以提升基础属性，强化战斗表现，并根据自身偏好的战斗风格规划成长路线。持续增强的能力与逐渐丰富的战术选择，将让后续战斗拥有更多层次与策略空间。

《Dance of Y》以“舞动对决”的独特氛围诠释经典回合制 RPG 的乐趣，在熟悉的角色成长与战术部署中加入轻盈而鲜明的表现主题。对于喜爱单人 RPG、热衷策略思考与角色培养的玩家而言，这将是一段兼具节奏感与挑战性的冒险旅程。

store_data.about_the_game:
《Beacon of Y》是一款以光芒与指引为主题的回合制角色扮演游戏，在经典 RPG 战斗机制中融入鲜明的探索氛围与稳健的策略体验。玩家将踏上一段追寻信标的旅程，在清晰而富有节奏感的回合战斗中指挥角色前进，通过每一次行动逐步点亮通往胜利的道路。

游戏采用传统回合制指令战斗系统，玩家需要在攻击、防御、技能释放与资源分配之间做出判断。面对不同类型的敌人与不断升级的挑战，单纯依靠数值优势并不足以取胜，合理观察局势、把握技能时机以及制定稳定的战斗节奏，才是突破难关的关键。

随着冒险不断深入，角色能力也将持续成长。玩家可以提升基础属性，强化战斗表现，并根据自身偏好的策略方向塑造成长路线。每一次强化都会带来新的战术选择，让后续战斗拥有更多变化与可能性。

《Beacon of Y》以“光之引导”为核心意象，为经典回合制 RPG 赋予独特的氛围表达。它既保留了传统角色扮演游戏的成长乐趣与策略深度，也让玩家在一步步前进的过程中体验不断接近目标的满足感，是一款适合喜爱单人冒险与战术思考玩家的作品。

store_data.about_the_game:
《Petal of Y》是一款以花瓣意象与自然韵律为主题的回合制角色扮演游戏，在经典 RPG 战斗框架中展现柔美而富有张力的冒险体验。玩家将在层层展开的旅途中操控角色，通过回合制指令完成攻击、防御、技能释放与成长规划，在稳定而富有策略性的节奏中感受传统角色扮演游戏的魅力。

游戏采用经典回合制战斗系统，每一次行动都需要谨慎思考。玩家需要根据敌人的状态与战场变化，在进攻与防守之间寻找平衡，并合理安排技能使用时机。看似平静的花瓣之下隐藏着激烈的较量，只有善于判断局势并灵活调整策略，才能在连续战斗中稳步前进。

随着冒险深入，角色将不断成长并获得更强的能力。玩家可以提升基础属性，强化战斗表现，打造更适合自身风格的成长路线。不同阶段的敌人与挑战也将推动玩家持续优化战术，在熟悉的 RPG 机制中体验循序渐进的成就感。

《Petal of Y》以清新鲜明的主题包装经典玩法，让传统回合制战斗拥有更加柔和而独特的表现氛围。对于喜爱单人 RPG、享受策略部署与角色培养的玩家而言，这将是一段值得投入其中的冒险旅程。

store_data.about_the_game:
No sound. No destruction. And yet… everything begins to change.

In Hollow Descent, you enter Ganides, the physical layer sustained by five core crystals.

Years ago, a green sphere descended upon the continent of Baedrish. Shortly after, a strange mist known as The Black Storm began to consume cities and distort reality.

Now, a new sphere has fallen in Escia… and history threatens to repeat itself.

Story & Experience

Take control of multiple characters, each with their own backgrounds and motivations, as they investigate the origin of the anomaly.

Explore cities and unknown regions as corruption spreads, threatening to consume everything in its path.

Complete quests and make choices that directly affect the world… and those around you.

Some allies will change. Others will disappear. Not all will survive your decisions.

Key Features

  • Narrative inspired by tabletop RPG campaigns, with an emphasis on choices and consequences.

  • Multiple playable characters with personal story arcs and unique abilities.

  • Exploration of cities, dungeons, and areas affected by the anomaly.

  • Turn-based tactical combat with strategic options and party management.

  • Main and side quests that influence the story and character relationships.

  • Impactful decisions that alter dialogue, character availability, and lead to multiple endings.

  • Deep lore set within an original universe.

  • Original art and music adapted to a classic RPG style.

Content & Format

  • Free demo: experience the first hour of the adventure and get a feel for the tone, mechanics, and characters.

  • Chapter 1: initial paid release featuring 4–6 hours of complete story content, complex side quests, and meaningful choices with consequences.

  • The full game will be released episodically until the campaign is complete (estimated total length: 50 hours). Each chapter will introduce new areas, characters, and narrative branches; decisions may impact future installments.

As The Black Storm spreads, reality begins to distort… and some will be unable to resist entering it.

The fate of Ganides will depend on your decisions.

Welcome aboard the flagship, Captain! Your mission?

Simple… Keep the Mothership fed, and leave nothing behind. Unlock upgrades to expand your operation and push deeper with every run. This is a piece of cake for you! 

TEAR APART THE PLANETS

Use bombs from your flagship to tear planetary cells apart and reveal the core beneath. Each planet is built from layered structures. Just... watch out for running out of fuel, Captain!

GATHER RESOURCES

Every planetary cell you tear apart drops resources. Haul them back to your Mothership to keep the system running. Each planet has its own resource types, so yes… you’ll need a plan.

UPGRADE YOUR FLEET

100+ permanent upgrades await you in the skill tree, Captain! Upgrade the flagship and Mothership, unlock autonomous units, and deploy wingmen to make runs faster, stronger, and more chaotic.

UNLOCK NEW PLANETS

18 planets, with different layers and various resources, have the same problem: they’re still intact. Choose your targets, expand your reach, keep pushing forward. Some planets are easier. Some… you’ll come back to later.

"The cyberpunk city is restless, exhausting, and never quiet. Even so, people still need somewhere to lean."

S4NCTU4RY is a cyberpunk deckbuilding idle game. Collect cocktail cards, arrange them across a 3×3 grid, and design the perfect synergy. Collect furnishings from across the cyberpunk world and bring your own bar to life.

  • 50+ Cocktail Cards: Collect and upgrade cards, each with its own tags and rarity.

  • Augments & Utility Cards: Specialize your playstyle with cybernetic utility cards earned as you play.

store_data.about_the_game:
Set sail into danger, mystery, and dark magic in Seven Seas Jewels 2!

A dark siren named Narissa has cast a cruel curse on Rowan, binding his life to an ancient vow of love for love. With each passing day, the spell drains his strength, pulling him closer to the depths where the curse was born.

Polly, the woman who loves him, refuses to accept this fate. Leaving behind safety and certainty, she sets sail across stormy seas, forgotten islands, and cursed shores in search of a way to break Narissa’s spell. Along the journey, she uncovers relics of old magic, faces supernatural threats, and learns how much love is truly willing to risk.

With 250 handcrafted levels, Seven Seas Jewels 2 invites you on a Match-3 adventure that unfolds alongside Polly’s quest to save Rowan. Each puzzle brings her closer to breaking the curse, revealing new story moments, magical locations, and secrets hidden beneath the waves. Choose Puzzle Mode for a satisfying challenge, or Relaxed Mode to enjoy the journey at your own pace.

Blending engaging puzzles with a heartfelt story, Seven Seas Jewels 2 is an adventure shaped by courage, sacrifice, and devotion.

Every puzzle matters.
Every choice brings hope closer.

Will love be strong enough to break the curse?

  • Story-driven Match-3 adventure

  • A heartfelt tale of love and sacrifice

  • 250 handcrafted Match-3 levels

  • Face 14 foes on your journey

  • Six new gameplay features with unique mechanics

  • 14 Spot the Difference mini-games

  • 13 relaxing picture tile puzzles

  • Fun mini-games like labyrinths, cards, and memory

  • Puzzle Mode or Relaxed Mode play

  • Beautiful, detailed visuals

store_data.about_the_game:
Coinqueror: Luck, Strategy, and Conquest!

Turn your mouse into a sword and your luck into your greatest weapon! Coinqueror is a turn-based strategy game that will drive your friends crazy, where you draw the borders yourself and the outcome of battles is decided by a coin flip.

Draw Your Borders, Take the Risk

Spotted an enemy or a neutral territory? Start your attack by drawing around it with your mouse. Will you attack a small village, or will you try to swallow a massive empire in one move? The choice is yours, but remember; a big bite means a big risk!

Once you draw your attack, it's all up to your luck. Flip the coin!

  • If you win: You conquer the entire area you drew and expand your borders.

  • If you lose: You forfeit a portion of your own lands to the enemy!

Festival Time!

In Chaos mode, a joyful Festival begins every 5 turns! Things change during this special turn:

  • Players cannot attack each other and peace prevails.

  • All attacks on neutral territories are 100% successful! Don't miss this chance to quickly conquer the map and grow!

Play with Friends

Coinqueror is best played with friends! Create a custom room code and battle it out on the same map with up to 4 players. Form alliances, make secret pacts via the diplomacy panel, and stab your best friend in the back when the time comes. Only one person can be the sole ruler of the map!

Chaos Mode: Economy and Walls

If you want to take the game to the next level, Chaos Mode is perfect for you!

  • Economy: You earn gold (Coins) every turn from Castles and Villages on the map.

  • Defensive Walls: Build walls on your borders with the gold you earn (60 Coins). If you lose the coin flip, your walls will be destroyed but your lands will remain yours! Building walls in strategic locations is the key to survival.

Flip the coin. Conquer the world or lose it all. Welcome to Coinqueror!

You're very good at this.                                          

Thirty seconds in, your paws start moving on their own. Your ears track beats you haven't heard yet. Your tail balances against musical phrases two bars ahead. The thinking part of you has left the building. Humans call this flow state.    

Then the staff flips upside down. Your paws know. The camera gets drunk. Your paws know. A fish falls from the rafters. Your paws were already there.                      

 

The melody arrives on time regardless of whether reality is upright.

  - Three moods per level: **Tutorial** (learn), **Play** (score), **Disaster** (transcend)

AUGUST WISEMAN: NO MORE BREAKUPS A fast-paced QTE boss rush with roguelite elements where love isn’t something you say, it’s something you survive. You play as August Wiseman, a high schooler who picked his game over his girlfriend one too many times. So she takes his phone and gives him a simple challenge: reach her at the end of the train if he wants it back. The catch? She, and everyone in her life, are aliens. Friends, family, exes… all waiting in the next car, each with their own way of “testing” you. And for them, love means fighting. The game is presented in a bold comic style with a mix of humor and honesty. Every boss feels ridiculous but they actually have something to say about love and relationships. FEATURES

QTE Combat

It’s all about timing. Miss the moment, and you’re done.

Boss Rush Only

No filler. Just one weird, personal fight after another.

Comic-Style Presentation

Panels, motion, and bold visuals that keep everything moving fast.

Roguelite Progression

Gain permanent upgrades and make each run easier than the last.

It’s funny, until it isn’t.

store_data.about_the_game:
About Thieves

About Thieves is an old-school, first-person dungeon crawler with real-time combat and grid-based movement. Descend through festering sewers, abandoned ruins, and royal dungeons, and loot every corner of them. Gold is experience, and secrets are everywhere. The more you steal, the stronger you get.

Features:

  • Exploration-driven progression: Your main source of XP is treasure. Hunt for secrets, crack open hidden rooms, and fill your pockets. Every coin counts.

  • Real-time grid-based combat: Classic dungeon crawling feel with fast, demanding fights against slimes, giant worms, corrupted Ratkins and worse.

  • Six playable classes with a rogue twist: Forget paladins and wizards. Here, the warrior is a guild strongman, the healer is a shady plague doctor, and the mage is a street illusionist with a knife up her sleeve. Classic fantasy archetypes, reimagined for a crew of thieves.

  • A story bigger than a heist: You went in for the gold. You might just save the entire province. Against your will.

The king hasn't left his castle in months. The people of Ashad are hungry. Someone has to do something, it might as well be someone who gets paid...

Overview
Gold & Brown is a choice-driven visual novel experience set in the harsh yet captivating atmosphere of the medieval era, telling the story of an impossible love and a perilous journey. As a knight, you bind your heart to the fate of a princess, where every decision you make shapes both the course of the story and your own destiny.

Story
A forbidden love blossoms behind the grand walls of a kingdom… Despite the barriers of society, war, and fate, you set out on a dangerous journey to reach the one you love. But this path demands more than courage; it requires wit, strategy, and the right choices.

Gameplay
Gold & Brown blends classic visual novel storytelling with card-based decision mechanics. Every encounter, dialogue, and turning point is shaped by the cards presented to you. These cards are not just choices—they represent risk, reward, and consequence.

What is the story about?

Echo of Me is a psychological narrative game about memory, loss, and a truth that cannot be left behind. After the death of her loved one, a young woman finds herself trapped in a maze of memories, trying to understand what really happened. By exploring its winding corridors, discovering notes, and unlocking new areas, she gradually reconstructs a chain of events where every new answer reshapes everything she thought she knew.

But the path to the truth will not be easy. To move forward, you will need to solve puzzles, open new passages, and find ways to reach hidden fragments of the past. The maze offers no easy explanations — it leads through broken memories, recurring details, and pieces of the past that only reveal their meaning over time.

And this place is not empty. Enemies roam the depths of the maze, determined to stop you from going any further. The closer you get to the truth, the more dangerous the journey becomes, and the more it feels that your loved one’s final words carried something far heavier than a simple wish to protect her from pain.

Will she reach the end and uncover the full truth? Or will she remain trapped in a world where memory clings to the past more tightly than reality itself?

Key features:

  • Explore an atmospheric maze of memories

  • Uncover the story through notes and hidden fragments of the past

  • Solve puzzles to unlock new areas and reach key parts of the story

  • Face enemies that stand in your way as you move deeper into the maze

  • Experience a narrative where each new discovery changes your understanding of the story

  • Immerse yourself in a tense psychological atmosphere with a strong focus on storytelling

  • Different zones bring different dangers.

  • Give your character a unique style

  • Upgrade your abilities to withstand dangerous zones in the maze

WHAT IS THE TRUE MEANING OF THE MAZE?

store_data.about_the_game:
Stone to Stove is a medieval-themed management game that combines daytime economic management with nighttime survival defense. During the day, you earn money by serving people, and at night, you use that income to build defense systems. The decisions you make each day determine whether you survive the next night.

The main goal of the game is to grow a small settlement into a self-sustaining base over time. You can generate income and increase your earnings by serving travelers quickly and accurately. However, every choice comes at a cost: if you take risks to earn more, you might neglect your defenses.

When night falls, enemies attack your base. You must counter these attacks by building defenses with your earnings and wisely planning your settlement.

Stone to Stove offers a deep strategy experience built on a simple cycle: earn, invest, and survive. Each new day brings greater opportunities, while the nights become more deadly.

Key Features:

Earn by day, defend by night: a cycle combining economy and survival

Build your base as you wish with a free-laying system

Different customer types and earning strategies

Risk-reward based resource gathering system

Defense building mechanics

Increasingly difficult enemy waves every day

In this world where every decision matters, how far can you go?

store_data.about_the_game:
THE ULTIMATE SPEED LIMIT AWAITS Start from a dead stop in the vast emptiness of space. Your objective is absolute: push your ship's velocity to 299,792,458 m/s and breach the speed of light. Lightspeed is a focused incremental simulation where physics, resource management, and rapid progression collide.

HARVEST, ACCELERATE, REPEAT Take direct manual control of your ship's collection arrays. Hover over drifting cosmic particles and exotic substances to scoop up fuel, watching your HUD tick upward as your velocity, acceleration, and percentage of lightspeed climb.

But momentum is fleeting. When your fuel inevitably runs dry, your velocity zeroes out. The downtime during refueling is your crucial window to access a sprawling upgrade tree, turning every hard stop into your next massive launch.

SYSTEMS MANAGEMENT & FRICTION Going fast isn't just about burning fuel; it's about engineering survival. You must balance multiple tiered systems to maintain your momentum:

  • Thermal Dynamics: Engines overheat if pushed too hard for too long. Invest in tiered cooling systems to extend your burn times.

  • Kinetic Shielding: The faster you travel, the more dangerous space becomes. Constantly upgrade your hull shielding to survive high-velocity cosmic impacts.

  • Velocity-Gated Matter: The rarest, highest-energy particles can only be seen and harvested while traveling at extreme speeds, forcing you to constantly push your limits to reach the next tier of technology.

DEEP INCREMENTAL PROGRESSION

  • Tiered Technology: Progress through increasingly complex tiers of particles, magnetic collection arrays, and propulsion engines.

  • Hypnotic Visuals: Enjoy a clean, minimalist aesthetic where different cosmic substances feature distinct, satisfying visual effects as they are collected.

  • Active Anomalies: Stay alert during your runs for random, high-density fuel tanks and anomalous particle clusters that require quick reflexes to capture for massive boosts.

  • Comprehensive Telemetry: Track every metric of your journey with a detailed HUD tracking velocity (m/s), distance traveled, total mass collected, fuel reserves, and shield integrity.

store_data.about_the_game:
The king must eat.

In this medieval incremental game, you begin with a few manual food stations and a simple kitchen. Click to process ingredients, combine them into dishes, and keep production moving long enough to turn humble supplies into meals fit for the crown.

As the days pass, your workshop grows into a sprawling food machine. Unlock new stations, automate old ones, improve ingredient quality, and discover better ways to turn basic ingredients into more valuable dishes. Better ingredients lead to better meals, and better meals bring better pay.

Each day is about preparation. Build your output, refine your production chains, and fill the kitchen before night falls. Each night, the king and his guests consume what you created and reward your work.

Then the court offers a darker path.

After enough progress, you can serve the king his last dish and trigger a prestige reset. Lose most of your current operation, keep powerful permanent bonuses, and begin again with faster production, stronger efficiency, and a new plan for the next reign.

Features

• Start with manual stations and automate your kitchen step by step.

• Process ingredients through layered medieval food production chains.

• Mix ingredients into a growing variety of dishes.

• Improve ingredient quality to increase the value of every meal.

• Play through a day-and-night loop of cooking, serving, and earning.

• Feed the king daily and prepare larger feasts for noble guests.

• Use a prestige system that resets progress for lasting upgrades.

• Optimize each run and push your royal kitchen further every cycle.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to Starry Station, a station that took children to space. Visit an old abandoned place called 'Starry Station'. Even though it has gone through a very ruined state after the shutdown some life still seems to lurk beneath the shadows.

A place with children excited for their first day at camp now rots with their and other's corpses. A place where the music has been frozen and replaced with nature's dark ambient creeks. Creatures that have rotted and lived through the horrors still walk through these ruined walls.

Even from the fame everything is unpredictable and no one knows the future leading Starry Station to close due to a disregarded event. However, you come back only a year later to find your missed loved one who was a highly regarded co-worker.

Cosmo & Her Friends:

Introducing one of Starry Station's most revolutionizing creations, "Cosmo Paw". a child's best friend. You can communicate with Cosmo through a newly founded cosmetic item "The Cosmo Radio". The Cosmo Radio was designed to look like a walkie-talkie mixed with a new screen with your favorite pal from Starry.

However, there is more than just one, there are four more in the earth wave of the creatures. But something has happened to the other four, some have gone rogue, and something has happened to their poor souls to make them act the way they do.

Exploring This Ruined Station:

Even if the place is ruined and starting to rot, your best friend Cosmo is always on your side. Explore Starry while finding new beasts, new and cute collectibles, and talking with your new silly best friend. Could you make sure to uncover the many hidden and secret areas that you were not meant to see?

Finally, find your way to a hidden and backup spacecraft to make your way out and find a new planet to explore to see what happened to this place and where your loved one has gone.

store_data.about_the_game:
A joke masquerading as a game. (The game is pretty fun too.)

You are the messiah. The miracles are wrong. The water becomes boxed wine. You walk under the sea instead of on it. Your disciples follow you around saying the wrong things. Roman soldiers drain your faith. You have to keep performing miracles to stay alive. Jesus lasted 33 years. You'll be lucky to last five minutes.

The Perfect Gift

Know someone who takes Jesus a little too seriously? This is for them. Know someone who genuinely thinks they're the Messiah? This is definitely for them. Messiah Simulator is a loving, blasphemous, surprisingly tender reminder that being the Messiah is impossible—and that's kind of the point.

Give it to your ultra-religious friend who needs to lighten up. Gift it to the person in your life who's convinced they're here to save everyone else. They'll figure out which one they are by the end of the first run. You can't fix them. But you can buy them a game where they get crucified and see how long they lasted.

Features:

  • Turn water into boxed wine (with a spigot)

  • Flip money-changer tables and watch the coins scatter

  • Throw unlimited loaves and fishes

  • Be followed by disciples with distinct personalities and terrible advice

  • Evade Roman Guards who slowly, creepily hunt you across the map

  • Watch your faith tick down as the Romans close in

  • Get crucified. See your survival time. Try again.

Delightfully blasphemous. Surprisingly tender. Buy it for the joke. Keep playing because it's actually fun.

store_data.about_the_game:
Defend your stars against an invading army of monsters led by a powerful Demon King.

In Glowbot Tower Defense, you must strategically place glowing robotic defenders along twisting space paths to stop waves of enemies before they overrun your galaxy. Each Glowbot has unique abilities, from energy blasts to chain lightning and explosive attacks, allowing you to build powerful defenses and adapt to increasingly chaotic waves.

Plan your layout, upgrade your towers, and survive intense battles as enemies grow stronger and faster. Only the smartest defenses will hold.

Key Features

Strategic Tower Placement
Carefully position your Glowbots along the path to maximize efficiency and stop enemies before they reach your base.

Unique Glowbot Abilities
Deploy a variety of towers, including:

  • Energy-based attackers

  • Chain lightning bots

  • Area-damage explosives

  • Support units that boost nearby towers

Online Leaderboards

Compete against players around the world on fully integrated online Steam leaderboards for every map. Your highest round survived is permanently recorded, allowing you to climb the global rankings and prove your defensive mastery.

Compare strategies, challenge friends, and see how far your defenses can truly go against endless waves of enemies.

Competitive Leaderboard Achievements

Glowbot Tower Defense features global online Steam leaderboards for every map, along with a set of prestigious competitive achievements for the most skilled defenders.

Leaderboard Achievements Include:

  • Reach the Top 10 on any map leaderboard

  • Reach the Top 10 on all map leaderboards

  • Become the #1 ranked player on any map

  • Become the #1 ranked player across all maps

These achievements are intentionally designed to be extremely challenging and highly competitive. Rankings can constantly change as players discover stronger strategies, optimize tower placements, and survive increasingly difficult waves. Only the greatest defenders in the galaxy will secure the top positions and earn these rare accomplishments.

Challenging Enemy Waves
Face multiple enemy types. From fast attackers to heavily armored units and powerful bosses that will test your defenses.

Multiple Space-Themed Maps
Defend your stars across vibrant, neon-filled environments with unique layouts and strategies.

Upgrade & Optimize
Earn diamonds, upgrade your towers, and refine your strategy to handle increasingly difficult waves.

Fast-Paced Gameplay Options
Speed up the action and push your defenses to the limit as chaos fills the screen.

Can You Survive the Invasion?

The Demon King’s forces are relentless. Build, adapt, and defend your galaxy before it’s too late.

store_data.about_the_game:
Good news:
The protracted struggle between the cult and the corporation has come to an end.

Bad news:
All the chickens have turned into mad chickens!

Creatures have become gigantic and ferocious. Defensive weapons—now attacking everyone.

What happened? How will you survive?

1. Scavenger Everything

Food, water, ammunition, gasoline, spare parts—every supply point could be a trap, or it could be your only hope.

Don't throw away the trash either; some trash can be fermented into gasoline or used to create useful/powerful items.

2. Upgrade Your Equipment and Tank

Strengthen your weapons and eggshells to survive longer.
Upgrade your tank's armor, modify its main gun, optimize its engine—turn this tank into your mobile fortress.

3. Uncover the Truth

Follow the clues, defeat the mutant leader and Deep Guard, piece together the origins of the "Mad Chicken Incident"—then, stop the world from collapsing further and escape!

Game Systems:

Vehicle Equipment System:

Main Gun - The primary method of attack, balancing weight, ammunition capacity, and power.

Secondary Gun - Less powerful but lighter, capable of carrying a large amount of ammunition.

Special Weapon - A bulky weapon with a small ammunition capacity but immense power.

Engine: Determines the vehicle's load capacity

Special Armor: Equipping these makes your vehicle immune to missiles/lasers/poison gas/freeze

Engine Load Capacity - Vehicle Weight = Maximum Armor Load

Modification System:

Modify your vehicle's weapons to make them more efficient

Modify your vehicle parts to increase load capacity

Modify your vehicle chassis to allow for more attachments

Modify your items/helmets/shells to make it easier to survive after dismounting

Prayer System:

If a shrine is built and suitable offerings are made, a special bonus can be obtained for a certain period of time.

Hardcore Survival System:

Constantly monitoring hunger and thirst levels to maintain basic physiological functions is fundamental to survival.

So we made Foxwood. A cozy survival game designed to be relaxing and approachable.
