A small world where curiosity is rewarded, not punished.

Play on your own, or share the experience with someone new to the genre.

And maybe… a first step toward bigger adventures later.

EXPLORE MANY CITIES

Set course to neighboring cities and afar, find promising merchants to trade with.

  • Diversity: Find human, dwarf and fairy merchants.

  • City Requests: Accept and complete city requests for rewards, or abandon for resources.

TRADE FOR WEALTH

Set course to neighboring cities and afar, find promising merchants to trade with.

  • Warehouse: Hand pick your trades for maximum efficiency with limited space

  • Matched trades: Access the auto matched trades between merchants

GUILD YOUR WAY

Explore common and character specific guild buildings

  • Relics: Find relics with your adventurer guild

  • Recruit Army: Recruit army from your barracks

KEEP A LOW PROFILE

Time is always ticking. As you build your empire in the shadows, the crown is searching for you.

  • Weekly Pressure: At the end of every week, Royal Scouts survey the land, increasing the global Suspicion Gauge.

  • Bribe the Scouts: Use your wealth strategically to pay off the scouts, pausing the suspicion meter to buy yourself crucial time.

  • Inevitable Conflict: When Suspicion inevitably hits 100%, your location is compromised, forcing an immediate tactical battle against the royal armies.

MANAGE YOUR ARMY

You cannot win a war with gold alone. Build and maintain a standing army capable of repelling royal attacks. Balance your forces across three distinct unit classes:

Final combat is designed with Direct and Counter interactions.

  • Might: Heavy, frontline bruisers with varying direct and counter abilities.

  • Swift: Rapid-striking flanking units with varying direct and counter abilities.

  • Arcane: Magic units with varying direct and counter abilities.

RALLY THE NOBILITY

As the rightful head of House Fairheart, you can leverage your status and growing wealth to turn the King's court against him.

  • Gather Support: Rally other noble houses to your cause before a battle begins.

  • Cripple the Enemy: Successfully gaining noble support directly weakens the enemy army's stats and troop numbers, turning the tide of war in your favor before swords ever clash.

THREE PLAYABLE CHARACTERS

  • Garrick (Human)

  • Brenda (Dwarf)

  • Olis (Fairy)

store_data.about_the_game:
IDENTITY

Agent 22, you have been assigned a new mission for T.U.N.C.H. You will infiltrate Unitas, assume a new identity, and relay intelligence.

You will operate as a repair technician at a military base.

MISSION OVERVIEW

During your shift, you will repair the devices brought to you by soldiers.

These devices will belong to military personnel and will play a critical role in our intelligence network.

You will have a limited amount of time to repair each device. If you are too slow, you will draw suspicion.

CORE GAMEPLAY

The devices you receive will have multiple layers and require different methods to fix. Identify the correct approach for each one and complete the repair.

During this process, you will encounter minigames with various puzzle mechanics. These minigames include an error margin—making too many mistakes will affect the status of your mission.

INTELLIGENCE SYSTEM

Each day, you must plant a listening device in one of the units. Every evening, we will inform you which device to target.

You will plant the bug and, later at home, tune your radio to its frequency and record what you hear.

Transmit any valuable information to us using Morse code.

DECISIONS AND CONSEQUENCES

Work with precision during repairs and avoid drawing suspicion.

There will be moments when you must make critical decisions—make the right ones and minimize errors. Analyze the situation and act in our favor.

RISK AND OUTCOME

The information you provide is vital to our position in the war.

Remember, you are alone. You are responsible for your actions and your mistakes.

store_data.about_the_game:
Capybara Bingo is a fast-paced, cozy party bingo game where up to 8 players manage 1–6 bingo cards simultaneously, racing to stamp called numbers and claim bingo before anyone else.

But call it wrong? You pay the price.

Classic Bingo. Cozy Chaos.

Numbers fly, cards pile up, and the good panic of scanning 6 cards at once is exactly the kind of chaos that makes everyone at the table laugh. Stamp any square at any time — bingo is only yours if you can prove it.

Key Features

  • Single-player vs 7 unique NPC capybaras, or online multiplayer for 2–8 players
  • Manage 1–6 bingo cards simultaneously
  • 9 round types: Regular, Double, Four Corners, Full Card, X-Shape, T-Shape, Postage Stamp, Outside Frame, and Blackout Speed
  • Chaos ability system — disrupt other players with power-ups earned by stamping
  • Earn Capy Tokens and unlock capybara characters, dotters, table skins, and more

How to Play

Numbers are called automatically. Stamp squares as they're called across all your cards. When you've got a winning pattern, hit your bingo key.

One More Round

Short sessions, low stakes, high laughs. Capybara Bingo is the bingo game that's actually fun to play with friends.

store_data.about_the_game:
[Master the Void, Defy the Gravity]

Alpha Star blends classic arcade shoot-'em-up thrills with a dynamic physics-based environment. It's not just about dodging bullets—it's about surviving the space-time distortions of massive black holes that pull everything into their grasp.

🚀 Key Features

  • Dynamic Space Battlefield: Experience a battlefield that reacts to physics. Encounter Black Holes that warp the trajectory of every projectile. Use their gravitational pull to your advantage or fight to stay outside the event horizon.

  • Evolving Threat Levels: Progress through 10 distinct mission phases. Face the "Red Storm" of high-velocity Super Bullets and dodge relentless volleys of seeker missiles as the sector's difficulty spikes.

  • Strategic Ship Upgrades: After every wave, choose from 3 randomized upgrade cards. Will you boost your Photon Engine for speed, deploy a Chrono Field to slow enemies, or prioritize the Rapid Recharge of your shields?

  • Dual-Layer Defense: Master the synergy between your ship’s hull and its Auto-Regenerating Shields. Knowing when to engage and when to retreat for a shield recharge is the key to survival.

  • Atmospheric Sci-Fi Soundtrack: Immerse yourself in the void with a haunting 80s-inspired dark synth-wave soundtrack that evolves with the intensity of the combat.

✨ Special Thanks & Credits

[ SOUND & MUSIC ]

  • Universfield - Dark 80s Sci-Fi Atmosphere

  • AtlasAudio - Ambient Cinematic

  • NastelBom - Cinematic Ambient

  • SLD Audio - Sci-Fi and Cyberpunk Music Pack

[ VISUAL ASSETS ]

  • NASA’s Goddard Space Flight Center / Jeremy Schnittman (Special thanks for the scientific visualization of black hole environments)

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

Start with a small, worn-down roadside motel and turn it into a profitable business. Manage rooms, serve guests, repair damage, clean up messes, and invest your earnings into upgrades that increase value and attract better customers.

Built as a solo passion project from scratch, this motel management simulator combines hands-on tasks, progression systems, and business management in one experience.

Manage Your Motel

Take control of the full guest experience from check-in to checkout.

Assign customers to available rooms, set prices based on room quality, upgrades, and cleanliness, then collect payments after their stay. Keep rooms in top condition to earn better rewards and tips.

Poorly maintained rooms lose value over time and are more likely to become damaged or dirty.

Clean, Repair, Repeat

Every room needs attention. After guests leave, inspect the damage and restore everything before the next booking.

Handle tasks such as:

  • Cleaning trash and messes

  • Replacing light bulbs

  • Repairing switches

  • Fixing damaged devices

  • Cleaning toilets

  • Restoring room condition

The better you maintain your motel, the more money you can earn.

Upgrade Every Room

Improve your rooms with furniture, appliances, and useful add-ons to permanently increase rental value.

Each room supports multiple upgrade slots, allowing you to customize layouts and create higher-tier accommodations.

Possible upgrades include:

  • Television

  • Microwave

  • Game console

  • Intercom

  • Coffee maker

  • Water dispenser

  • Towels

  • Air conditioner

  • Stove

Shop & Expand

Buy supplies and upgrades in physical stores early in the game, then unlock remote ordering through your phone or laptop for faster management later. Plan purchases carefully and keep your motel stocked with everything needed to stay operational.

Upgrade Your Character

Use the special reception TV to unlock player bonuses and improve your efficiency.

Possible upgrades include:

  • Higher room rental income

  • More inventory space

  • Faster movement speed

  • Extra rewards for repairs

Build Storage & Organize Supplies

Use the warehouse behind reception to build shelves and organize your growing business.

Create better storage systems to hold cleaning products, spare parts, furniture, and more.

Optional Side Income

Take a break from motel work and grow potted plants in the warehouse for extra profit.

A small optional system for players who enjoy additional progression and cozy side activities.

Solo Passion Project!

This is my first game, fully created solo from scratch. Every system is being built with care, with the goal of delivering a polished and rewarding management experience.

I hope all of you will have at least a little fun playing it. And if there are things you don’t like, or something you feel could be better, I hope you’ll give me the chance to improve it and make the game better with your feedback.

store_data.about_the_game:
SIT OR DIE is a 3D multiplayer party game with a dark and suspenseful twist. As prisoners trapped by a mad warden, you are forced to play a deadly game of musical chairs.

Core Game Mechanics:

Music stops, time to grab a chair.Sitting does not necessarily mean you are safe.There's a chance to turn things around even while standing.

Every round is different
Over 30 game modes are randomly combined in each match. You never know what comes next—react fast, trust your luck, or outplay others.
(Demo includes 10 modes.)

NEW Skill: Push and Kick.

We listened to the players' feedback and decided to add more interactivity to the musical chairs phase. You can push away your fellow inmate competing for a chair, or kick them down.

Note that both actions have a limited number of uses, so use them carefully to maximize your chances of survival.

Not enough players? Add AI
Supports 1–12 players. If fewer than 6 players join, you can add AI prisoners up to 12. They compete, eliminate, solve tasks… and can be even more cunning than real players.

More Modes.

From the basic "musical chairs" game, there are over 30 different modes, so you can never guess what you'll face in the next round.

Don't let your guard down; the situation could turn around at any time.

FAKE chair or TRUE chair ？

Faced with a mix of real and fake chairs, do you try them one by one, or wait for your fellow inmates to finish?

More modes will be revealed soon!

Try your best to survive.

Become a ghost after elimination (Feature under development).
Once eliminated, you turn into a ghost. Take revenge on those who defeated you—or prank your friends and drag them down with you.

Can you survive to the end and claim the throne of thorns?

"I am trapped in this miniature world. Please, help me."

When you awaken, a goddess speaks these words to you.
There may be no way out—but there is no other choice.

You take control of a rabbit and set out to collect five medals scattered across this world.

  • Explore a roughly 1 km-wide open field

  • Find medals hidden throughout the world and return them to the goal

  • No enemies, but unstable platforms, environmental hazards, and deadly falls stand in your way

  • Practice features let you retry difficult sections as many times as you like

Place respawn points almost anywhere.
Learn, retry, and overcome each challenge at your own pace.

store_data.about_the_game:
In the minimalist world of Lightfold, the key to unraveling puzzles lies at the border of light and dark. Playing as a little cat in this purely geometric space, you will move light sources and obstacles to shape shadows, engaging in a satisfying mental workout of visual and spatial logic.

Core Gameplay: Sokoban Meets Silhouette Puzzles

In Lightfold, your ultimate goal is the "shape." You must simultaneously manipulate two distinct elements: illuminating light sources and light-blocking blocks. By precisely controlling the distance and angle between them, you will use the principles of projection to piece together and overlap specific target shadow patterns on the ground or walls.

Game Features

  • Dual Puzzle-Solving Mechanics: You must carefully plan the cat's path to avoid dead ends, while simultaneously visualizing how shadows will stretch, shrink, or merge as the relative positions of the lights and blocks change.

  • Intuitive Shadow Puzzles: There are no complex text tutorials. Observe the target silhouette and reverse-engineer the correct positions for the light sources and blocks. Every step you take provides immediate and realistic visual feedback from the dynamically shifting light and shadow.

  • Pure Minimalist Aesthetics: Clean geometric shapes, high-contrast lighting, and tranquil ambient sounds. Free from cluttered UI elements, the game allows you to fully immerse yourself in a state of pure puzzle-solving flow alongside the little cat.

store_data.about_the_game:
A fast paced bullet heaven FPS played with just the mouse where your speed is your fire rate.

As a member of the Hypervibers you will complete missions for the Hypervibers fighting against inhuman hordes in the Dronelord's Domain to ultimately take down the Dronelord.

Accelerate, glide and surf across procedurally generated zones. Ramp off of the terrain to fly through the air raining down bullets from above, leveling up to fill the screen with bullets.

Features

  • Mouse only control scheme so you can sit back and enjoy a snack while you play.

  • Automatic weapons triggered by movement conditions such as landing from the air.

  • A new fast paced take on the movement and positioning gameplay of the bullet heaven genre.

  • A choice of characters to play, each starting with one weapon and a unique movement ability triggered by the scroll wheel.

  • Fight waves of drones across a variety of procedurally generated levels.

  • Automatic targeting so you can focus on movement.

  • In game guide with detailed explanations of mechanics and controls.

  • Complete runs across 3 zones lasting roughly 8 minutes each.

  • Level up to choose between weapons, stat upgrades from cyberchips and upgrades to your existing loadout.

  • Find the cargo crate in each level to unlock bonus stat upgrades or add additional weapons and cyberchips to your loadout.

Story

In a distant future in a distant place there lived a man who ran a simple delivery business. One day he decided to amass a fleet of drones to make the job easier for himself and lower his operating costs. As he amassed drones he became more isolated, never traveling far from his warehouse, anything he needed he could deliver to himself. Over time he grew to see his automatons as companions, then friends and finally equals. He'd begun manufacturing them himself, learning about robotics and even cybernetics until one day he took the plunge turning himself into a cyborg, losing sight of his initial motivations in the process and yearning only to cover the surface of the planet with as many of his friends as possible. Humans no longer mattered to him and so his drones were fitted with mechanisms to erase them from existence.

Cyborgs weren't uncommon in this time and place and as the Dronelord's horde grew a small resistance force of augmented humans grew. They were more selective than the Dronelord choosing to optimise their bodies instead of replacing the vital parts that made them human. They installed cyberchips in a special interface port they had designed and created a wireless connection to the hoverboards that were the common mode of transport. When the Dronelord began to attack humans these cyborgs known as Hypervibers entered the lands around his warehouse. Most regions had been bled dry, left barren, covered in metal plating or exposed wastes of lava where mining processes had weakened the planet's crust. Few areas had grass and even those were devoid of living beings.

Join the Hypervibers to embark on reconnaissance missions, scouting new zones in the dronelords domain. As you progress you will slowly make progress destroying key Dronelord infrastructure and creating a path to finally take down the Dronelord in the fortress that was once his warehouse.

Controls

This game can be played entirely with Mouse movement and left and right click.

There is also controller support using the left and right trigger and left analogue stick to match the mouse controls.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the Upper Echelons.

Nova Impact is an adrenaline-fueled 2D Space Shooter RPG (SSRPG) where survival is your only path to glory. You are a Zenith, an elite licensed pilot taking part in humanity’s ultimate combat simulation. But in this arena, you are the ultimate prize.

Relentless waves of unlicensed challengers, known as the Trackers, will hunt you down like a pack to steal your license. Your mission? Outmaneuver the swarm, rack up kills, and prove you are the #1 champion.

UNINTERRUPTED ACTION: PRE-PLAN YOUR BUILD

Say goodbye to menus that break your flow. In Nova Impact, the action never stops! Plan your ship's upgrade path before you enter the arena. As you destroy Trackers and gain XP, your ship automatically levels up and deploys your pre-selected enhancements. Focus entirely on dodging, shooting, and surviving the swarm.

EARN CREDITS & V.O.I.D. POINTS

Every single kill in the arena is tracked. At the end of each run, your combat performance is converted into two crucial resources: Credits and V.O.I.D. points. Spend your hard-earned Credits to purchase powerful modules that permanently reinforce your ship's capabilities. Meanwhile, accumulate V.O.I.D. points (Virtual Orbit & Interstellar Duels) to climb the division leaderboards and prove your worth to the League.

CLIMB THE LEAGUE & DUEL THE ELITE

You start at the bottom of the Zenith ladder, but your ambition doesn't stop there. As you survive longer and push your limits, you will unlock new routes in the League. Once you reach the top of the ranks, prepare for the ultimate challenge: intense, 1-on-1 boss fights against rival Zeniths to claim their spot.

A LIVING, EVOLVING COSMOS

Fight over a sleek, tactical Hex-Grid while the universe comes to life beneath you. Thanks to a stunning multi-layered parallax system, watch breathtaking nebulas form and massive planets materialize in the deep space background as the simulation intensifies.

  • Fast-Paced SSRPG Gameplay: A perfect blend of classic arcade space shooting and deep RPG progression.

  • Zero-Pause Leveling: Pre-plan your build and enjoy uninterrupted combat as your ship upgrades automatically.

  • The Tracker Swarm: Survive against massive, diverse waves of desperate challengers hunting you down.

  • Deep Customization & Ranking: Convert your arena kills into Credits to buy permanent ship modules, and accumulate V.O.I.D. points to climb the competitive ladder.

  • Epic 1v1 Boss Duels: Climb the division ranks and defeat rival Zeniths to become the #1 pilot.

  • Dynamic Environments: Experience a gorgeous, multi-layered background that evolves as you fight.

store_data.about_the_game:
Explore a detailed map featuring numerous locations and a dynamic day-night cycle. Every corner is filled with interactive elements that pull you deeper into the unique provincial atmosphere.

Along the way, you will meet three girls, each with her own distinct personality, struggles, and hobbies. To succeed, you must find a unique approach to each of them and navigate their individual questlines.

Beyond romantic interests, you can build meaningful connections with friends, relatives, and a diverse cast of characters, each featuring their own unique personality and dedicated questline. The game is packed with interactive depth: from shopping for various items and engaging in micromanagement gameplay to branching dialogues where your choices truly shape the unfolding narrative.

This isn’t an attempt to reconstruct reality, but rather to capture a specific mood. It’s an echo of an era when cities were less polished, yet somehow felt more alive. Today, the streets are cleaner, the facades brighter, and the spaces more convenient. And yet, the memory holds onto the warmth of those courtyards, stairwells, and vacant lots where an entire generation grew up.

Always Summer Out Here is a journey into that very feeling. It’s a place that never truly existed, but one that everyone will recognize.

store_data.about_the_game:
Jianghu Cangfeng is a martial arts turn-based party-building roguelike RPG set in a dangerous jianghu world.

Lead your heroes into mysterious realms filled with battles, random events, treasure, rest points, and difficult choices. Every step consumes supplies, and every encounter tests your planning, martial arts setup, equipment choices, and resource management.

The game features techniques from multiple martial arts sects, as well as wandering jianghu styles. Skills differ in damage types, cooldowns, energy costs, buffs, debuffs, dispels, cleanses, interruptions, and channeling effects. Build each character around their role, combine techniques with equipment, and adapt your strategy to different enemies.

During each expedition, you may gain temporary raid perks, equipment rewards, and event outcomes that change your run. Choosing when to take risks, when to conserve supplies, and how to prepare for key battles is central to survival.

This is not a game about simply overpowering enemies with numbers. It is about making choices under pressure, shaping your martial arts build, and slowly forging a party that can survive the hidden dangers of the jianghu.

Key Features:

- Martial arts turn-based combat

- Party building with multiple playable characters

- Techniques from different sects and wandering jianghu styles

- Character growth shaped by skills, equipment, and temporary raid perks

- Expedition-based exploration with supply management

- Random events, treasure, rest points, and combat encounters

- Combat mechanics including buffs, debuffs, dispels, cleanses, interruptions, and channeling

- Strategic choices that shape each run

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to your new job at Bowl City High School! You could have sworn the place has been abandoned your whole life, but you need the paycheck. The teachers there do get a bit quirky at night, so you must be on guard. Don't worry though, Mr. Phone is there to give you instructions to survive the night, and with more than 8 teachers to keep track of, you must listen carefully: use the cameras to check the teacher's positions and plan ahead, complete your homework to stop Mr. Math, block off vents to keep the teachers at bay, and use hiding spots to sneakily avoid the teachers. The school runs on limited power, so limiting consumption is key, and Micheal Science doesn't appreciate your power usage, so make sure to keep your usage down to a minimum. Most importantly, however... you must stop Mr. Gut... 

Once you've made it through the first 6 nights, overtime is an option, but it is unadvised due to extreme safety hazards. Other nights are available as well, like the custom night for extra challenges and rewards.


Can you survive five nights at Bowl City High School?

This game was created using Godot game engine.

store_data.about_the_game:
Bloomtide

Every morning, a 9×9 board reshuffles from your filling pool. Apples, lightning, hawks, cherry blossoms — what ends up next to what decides how much you earn today. You have one job: pay the rent.

But the real game is turning "enough" into an explosion.

Core Loop

  • The board reshuffles every day — same pool, new layout. Adjacent relationships create new synergies each run.

  • Event queue resolution — growth, devour, movement, decay, burst. One event triggers the next, chaining into exponential payoffs.

  • Daily 3-pick (CoreItem) — add a new symbol type, or weight an existing one. Slowly bend the random board toward your archetype.

  • Rent at the end of each cycle — survive the rent check, then pick a BuffItem or EffectItem to amplify whatever build is forming. Cycles get longer as you progress; rent keeps climbing.

Three Strategy Layers

  • Board (CoreItem) — define what can show up on your board.

  • Environment (EffectItem) — Snowy Mountain accelerates growth. Deep Sea strengthens devouring. Match your archetype.

  • Equipment (BuffItem) — multiplier wands, xmult rings. Take a working build and break the numbers.

"I went growth-fruits → I need the snowy mountain → I need the multiplier wand." When the build clicks, you feel the machine working for you.

Two Modes

  • Campaign — 12 rent payments to win. A guided ramp through every mechanic.

  • Endless — rent stops scaling at run 14. All items unlocked. No survival pressure — just "how far can my build push the numbers?"

Why You Won't Stop

  • Numbers go up — hard. A modifier pipeline (chips_add → chips_mul → mult_add → mult_mul → xmult) takes a good hand from dozens to millions in a single resolve.

  • Hidden combos to discover. A hawk eating a snake poisons the field. A cherry blossom hitting zero blows up everyone. Hundreds of cross-item interactions waiting.

  • Every run is different. Archetypes × environments × equipment = a vast space of viable builds.

  • Simple rules, emergent depth. Each item is readable at a glance. The combinations are not.

  • Stylized symbol art. Every piece is readable at a glance — high information density, zero recognition cost.

store_data.about_the_game:
A decade and almost 1 million mobile downloads later, Skillful Pixel Dungeon comes to Steam.

Dive into a challenging roguelike RPG where every run tells a different story. Choose from four distinct classes, each offering unique active and passive abilities that open up multiple playstyles. Whether you favor brute force, precision, or strategy, no two journeys feel the same.

Descend through 25 procedural generated levels filled with danger, secrets, and loot, culminating in five formidable bosses that will test your mastery. With ever-changing dungeons and meaningful build variety, Skillful Pixel Dungeon delivers a fresh, high-stakes experience every time you play.

Pick one of 4 classes

Warrior

The warrior relies on brute strength and toughness in combat. His skills are close combat oriented leveraging melee weapons and high durability. The gladiators excel in single melee combat while berserkes are all around strong and can attack multiple enemies in one attack.

Mage

The mage relies on magic and minions to battle the forces of evil. The battle mage subclass boosts wand damage and allows using mana to absorb damage while the warlock turns his minions into even more feared beasts.

Rogue

The rogue relies on stealth and speed. Some rogues are so fast they can create copies of themselves while others excel in stealth allowing them to instantly take out sleeping enemies.

Huntress

The huntress is the weakest of all physically but her ranged skills make sure no enemy comes to close. The huntress's knowledge with the bow gives her access to skills like fletching and kneeshot. The warden is capable of shooting two arrows in one go as well as hunting animals passively for food. Snipers are capable of putting enemies to sleep and even attaching explosives to arrows.

Mercenaries

The hero is not alone on his quest. He can hire one of five mercenaries to aid him on his quest. The mercs come with basic equipment that may need replacement as the levels get tougher.

Brute

The toughest of mercenaries. A brute is slow but capable of soaking a lot of damage. He is also of capable of carrying any item in the carry slot.

Wizard

The wizard is physically weak but can summon rats in combat.

Thief

The thief is very fast and relies on stealth. His attack may poison enemies.

Archer

The archer does not have a lot of health so she attacks from distance. She has a habit of attacking kneecaps.

Archer Maiden

The elite version of archer mercs. Archer maidens are more expensive but worth the investment.

Rogue

The rogue relies on stealth and speed. Some rogues are so fast they can create copies of themselves while others excel in stealth allowing them to instantly take out sleeping enemies.

Huntress

The huntress is the weakest of all physically but her ranged skills make sure no enemy comes to close. The huntress's knowledge with the bow gives her access to skills like fletching and kneeshot. The warden is capable of shooting two arrows in one go as well as hunting animals passively for food. Snipers are capable of putting enemies to sleep and even attaching explosives to arrows.

Mercenaries

The hero is not alone on his quest. He can hire one of five mercenaries to aid him on his quest. The mercs come with basic equipment that may need replacement as the levels get tougher.

Brute

The toughest of mercenaries. A brute is slow but capable of soaking a lot of damage. He is also of capable of carrying any item in the carry slot.

Wizard

The wizard is physically weak but can summon rats in combat.

Thief

The thief is very fast and relies on stealth. His attack may poison enemies.

Archer

The archer does not have a lot of health so she attacks from distance. She has a habit of attacking kneecaps.

Archer Maiden

The elite version of archer mercs. Archer maidens are more expensive but worth the investment.

store_data.about_the_game:
Idle Defense throws you into a hypnotic, minimalist arena where neon cubes of every color surge toward you. You can crush them yourself or build an automatic defense grid that grinds them down while you strategize.

This isn't just another idle game. It's a deep, neon-soaked loop of progression, prestige, and pure destruction.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Dual-Mode Destruction – Play actively by smashing cubes with your mouse, or go idle by purchasing automated turrets that fire non-stop. Both paths are viable. Both are rewarding.

  • 7 Cube Colors = 7 Currencies – Each color has its own resource, its own upgrade tree, and its own behavior. All seven can swarm your screen at once. Manage the chaos.

  • 25 Base Upgrades – Split across three core pillars:
    Cube upgrades, Idle turret upgrades, Mouse upgrades.

  • Prestige System – Reset your progress to permanently boost your base upgrade power with multipliers and raise upgrade base levels. Each prestige makes the next run noticeably stronger.

  • Tiers Difficulty – Complete specific objectives to ascend to higher Tiers. Each new Tier ramps up the danger—and the rewards.

  • Perk System – Unlock passive skills and unique bonuses based on your total enemies defeated. The more you kill, the more specialized your build becomes.

  • Boss Waves – Summon massive, high-risk waves at will. Defeat the boss to claim exclusive rewards that normal cubes never drop.

  • Minimalist. Neon. Satisfying. – No clutter. No distraction. Just a grid, vivid cubes, sharp particle effects, and clean UI. It looks simple. It plays deep.

Add Idle Defense to your wishlist and dive into the neon grind very soon!

store_data.about_the_game:
About Hearts in Open Water


Hearts in Open Water is an adult romance visual novel set aboard M/Y Halcyon, a 55-meter superyacht working a high-pressure Mediterranean charter season while quietly preparing for a looming sale. You play as Reeve, a disciplined ex-Royal Navy captain whose authority is absolute on the water—and whose job depends on a single line in a closing memo.

Over twelve weeks of procedures, port calls, and midnight requests that never make it into the official log, three women step across thresholds only the captain controls. Choose one route, live one romance—and learn what a season-ending decision really costs.

Meet the Cast




Cosima — The Owner's Suite
Cosima Lasry is the perfectly photographed wife of a hedge-fund titan—and the most strategic person on the yacht. As her marriage approaches a contractual deadline, she begins using the vessel's routines to carve out an escape that no one is allowed to notice. To Reeve, she is both principal and pressure point: a woman who understands his discretion, and knows exactly how to ask for it.



Anouk — The Survey
A senior yacht sales broker with a six-figure commission on the line, Anouk boards Halcyon as the buyer's observer—clipboard in hand, reputation sharpened to a blade. Her closing memo contains a retention line that can keep Reeve in command or quietly end his tenure. Their relationship is a controlled collision of ambition and attraction: two people trained to keep everything on record, tempted by what happens when the record is closed.



Tully — The Interior
Promoted to Chief Stewardess on Reeve's signature, Tully runs the yacht's luxury like a mission—fast, flawless, and almost invisible until she chooses not to be. Behind the polished service is a private urgency: her sister's chemo back in Brisbane, paid for by the very season she cannot afford to leave. With Reeve, her romance is built on mutual competence and late-night honesty—two professionals choosing each other in the only gaps the job allows.

Key Features


  • Single-choice romance routes with high-stakes intimacy: commit to one love interest and follow a focused, escalating relationship shaped by your decision.
  • A superyacht romance grounded in power, protocol, and consequence: maritime law, chain of command, and professional distance are the central tension.
  • The Logbook as a living threat: what gets recorded, what gets omitted, and what can never be erased drives the story's suspense.
  • Three distinct romantic arcs, three distinct worlds: The Interior, The Survey, and The Owner's Suite.
  • A seasonal clock you cannot stop: the sale closes, the charter ends, and the vessel moves on—no matter what you choose.
  • Each romance route includes explicit adult scenes.

store_data.about_the_game:
Galaxiwilds is a narrative-driven space exploration experience focused on discovery, first contact, and uncovering the unknown.

Reality is breaking.

Across multiple universes, rifts tear through space, black holes behave unpredictably, and entire systems collapse without warning. These phenomena are not random—they are connected.

Your mission is not to conquer.
It is to understand.

Travel between universes, chart strange systems, and make contact with 75 unique alien civilizations, each with their own culture, history, technology, and perspective on the unfolding crisis.

Some will share knowledge.
Some will grant you new abilities.
Some will offer allies you can call upon—individuals with their own personalities, insights, and stories to tell.

As your network grows, so does your understanding of what lies beyond the rifts… and what may be causing them.

But this is not a guided journey.

Clues are not handed to you. Coordinates are not saved. Information must be observed, remembered, and recorded.

The truth is out there—but only if you’re paying attention.

store_data.about_the_game:
Medieval vs Machines is an incremental tower defense auto-battler about building a medieval army to defend your castle against a massive invasion of machines from another dimension.

Your kingdom was peaceful… until the sky split open and strange mechanical armies came pouring through. Robots, cyber soldiers, tanks, and war machines now march toward your land. Your only choice is to raise an army, strengthen your defenses, and fight back.

Build your forces from humble medieval troops into a powerful fantasy army. Recruit warriors, lancers, archers, knights, and even mighty monsters to protect your castle. Every unit has a role in battle, and every upgrade brings you closer to surviving the next wave.

Build Your Medieval Army

Start small, then grow into a full battlefield force. Add more troops, improve their stats, and unlock new ways to fight the machine horde.

Train and upgrade:

  • Sword-wielding warriors

  • Long-range archers

  • Charging lancers

  • Heavy armored knights

  • Powerful fantasy monsters

  • Defensive towers and castle upgrades

As your army grows, battles become larger, louder, and more chaotic.

Defend Against the Machine Horde

The machines do not stop. Each wave brings more enemies, stronger units, and deadlier attacks. Fight against robotic soldiers, futuristic weapons, armored vehicles, and cybernetic monsters from another dimension.

Your medieval army may look simple, but with the right upgrades, even swords and bows can stand against steel and lasers.

Incremental Progression

Medieval vs Machines is built around satisfying incremental growth. Earn resources from battle, spend them on upgrades, and come back stronger every wave.

Upgrade your troops, improve your castle, unlock new units, and push deeper into the machine invasion. Every run makes your army stronger and your defenses harder to break.

Unlock Skill Trees

Customize your strategy through skill trees. Improve your troops, boost your towers, unlock special upgrades, and shape your army around your favorite playstyle.

Focus on overwhelming numbers, powerful elite units, stronger defenses, faster attacks, or monster-based chaos.

Massive Auto-Battler Battles

Once the battle begins, your army fights automatically. Watch huge pixel-art battles unfold as medieval soldiers clash against futuristic machines.

Battles can grow into massive 100 vs 100+ fights filled with arrows, blades, bullets, explosions, monsters, and robots.

Your job is to prepare the army.
Their job is to hold the line.

Charming Pixel Art Style

Enjoy a fun contrast between cute medieval fantasy units and colorful cyberpunk machines. The battlefield is full of personality, from tiny knights and archers to giant monsters and mechanical invaders.

  • Auto-battler style combat

  • Build and upgrade a medieval army

  • Defend your castle against machine hordes

  • Recruit warriors, lancers, archers, knights, and monsters

  • Unlock skill trees and customize your troops

  • Large-scale 100 vs 100+ pixel-art battles

  • Medieval fantasy vs cyberpunk machine theme

  • Charming pixel art and chaotic battlefield action

Defend the Castle

The machines want your land.
Your army stands in their way.

Build your kingdom. Upgrade your troops. Hold the castle.

This is your land. Defend it.

store_data.about_the_game:
⚠️ NO-HORROR MODE AVAILABLE

This game includes an optional mode where jump scares and psychological elements can be disabled, allowing you to play using only the card‑game mechanics.

In the Exiled Prison, scares remain active, as they are part of the core challenge.

Memo R.I.P. is a first‑person psychological horror card game for 1–4 players with real‑time voice. Every match blends strategy, tension, and dynamic scares. The game features 6 rooms, each containing 150 unique scares, for a total of 900 events that react to your Madness Bar. The higher it gets, the more vulnerable you become: you’ll see the entity that lives in the room, hear it, feel it, and fall for its distractions—forgetting your hand’s value and losing the match.

First‑person card gameplay

You play on cozy‑futuristic tables inside a spaceship, lit by stable or unstable neon depending on the room’s state. Each room has its own entity, its own behavior, and its own way of watching and manipulating you. You don’t know which one you’ll get. You don’t know which card will wake it up. You don’t know when it will move behind you.

Dynamic psychological horror

The Blackbell System alters the rules in real time. AI fills empty player slots. Vivox transmits your breathing, doubts, and reactions… but during Blackbell, you won’t hear your teammates—yet they will hear you. The six card‑game variants completely change the pace of each match.

The Exiled Prison

Winning a match is not the end. At certain levels, the trial of the Exiled Boss awaits: you wake up in the Exiled Prison, an explorable map inspired by PT, Visage, and Resident Evil. Find the Four Cards of Madness, solve puzzles, and survive the whispers trying to break your mind. Each victory progresses your 20‑level journey, unlocking new characters, deck designs, and card backs.

Progression and the Exiled Boss

Defeating the Exiled Boss unlocks a new map aboard the S.C. Defender, featuring reactive music, 150 unique scares, and a different entity. The cycle continues until level 20. You can defeat the Exiled Boss only five times to unlock the five hidden maps—each attempt harder than the last. Losing means returning to the table, winning a match, going back to the Prison, finding the four cards, and challenging the boss again for a new S.C. Defender room.

Menu → Lobby → Match (Victory) → Prison → Boss → New Map

Characters, cosmetics, and languages

The game includes 10 base characters, and through progression and cosmetics you can reach a total of 36 playable characters. With a Skull‑based economy and support for 44 languages, Memo R.I.P. blends psychological horror, strategy, and exploration into an experience that never repeats itself.

store_data.about_the_game:
A dark-fantasy RPG about breaking the boundary between worlds... and surviving what comes through.

Veilbreak is a story-driven JRPG where reality itself is beginning to fracture. Across the land, ancient seals are failing... and something from beyond is pushing its way in.

What begins as a desperate escape from a cult ritual quickly spirals into a world on the brink of invasion. Portals tear open without warning. Creatures not meant for this world slip through, And somewhere beyond the Veil... something far worse is waiting.

You’ll lead a party of unlikely heroes- each pulled into a conflict far bigger than themselves. As the fractures spread, so does the truth:

This isn’t just an invasion.

It’s a search.

And you are being hunted.

Travel across coastal cities, ancient spires, underground trenches, and forgotten ruins as you track the source of the breaches. From the vibrant streets of Azura Bay to the depths of corrupted temples, every region brings new threats... and new answers.

Face twisted guardians, Veil-touched monstrosities, and powerful entities slipping between worlds. Close the fractures. Survive the encounters, and uncover why the barrier between realms is breaking... and who-or what-is trying to tear it down completely.

store_data.about_the_game:
Bench Simulator is a narrative simulation game where you experience the world from the perspective of a park bench.

Across several in-game days, different people come to the park, sit on the bench, and leave behind pieces of their lives. Couples, strangers, lonely night visitors, suspicious characters, families, and emotionally troubled people all pass through the same quiet place. You cannot walk, speak, or directly control them — but your small reactions can influence what happens.

As the bench, you observe conversations, read emotional situations, and react through subtle interactions such as shaking, shifting, creaking, or staying completely still. A small movement at the right time may interrupt an argument, create an awkward silence, comfort someone, or change the direction of a conversation.

Bench Simulator is not about action or combat. It is about presence, memory, timing, and the quiet impact of being there.

Every visitor brings a different story. Some moments are funny, some are romantic, some are uncomfortable, and some are emotionally heavy. As days pass, certain characters may return, previous choices may matter, and the bench slowly becomes a silent witness to the changing lives around it.

Key Features

- Play as a park bench in a unique narrative simulation experience

- Observe and influence conversations through subtle physical reactions

- Meet different visitors across multiple in-game days

- Experience emotional, funny, romantic, mysterious, and melancholic stories

- Make small choices that can affect character relationships and outcomes

- Discover recurring character arcs and different story consequences

- Experience day, evening, and night encounters with changing atmosphere

- Minimal, story-focused gameplay built around dialogue and observation

- Multiple outcome variations based on how you react during key moments

You are not the hero.

You are not the villain.

You are the bench.

You cannot speak.

You cannot leave.

But you can remember.

store_data.about_the_game:
Backrooms: Case Violet

A missing girl. An endless nightmare. A detective who refuses to leave without her.

Story:

In 1982 detective Jackson Webb is sent to Investigate a missing persons report for Violet Blackthorne, a 19 year old run away, After retracing her last known location he is sent to an abandoned warehouse where after finding no trace of Violet noclips through the floor into a yellow office space that seems to go on forever.

Now faced with surviving and escaping his new predicament he finds traces of violet in these backrooms and is on a mission to bring himself and violet back home.

Gameplay:

Set in the multi levelled backrooms found in the wiki dot lore, you find yourself able to traverse multiple levels to find resources to survive, with a rare ability to noclip inside the backrooms transporting yourself into a private homebase for base building, item storage and a safe space to plan your next ventures into the depths of this infinite procedurally generated hellscape.

As a detective hell bent on bringing violet home you complete quests that lead you across all levels chasing any hint you can find about violets whereabouts, but be careful as you'll be battling and running away from all the entities hellbent on killing you first.

  • Survive procedurally generated backrooms while dealing with entities trying to kill you.

  • Juggle with your food, water and sanity while traversing different levels of backrooms lore.

  • Craft weapons and other tools to help aid in your survival.

  • Investigate clues that lead you to Violet.

ABOUT THE GAME

The war ended an hour ago. The field is littered with bodies. Crows are already gathering. And you — just hungry teenagers from a nearby village trying to survive.

Welcome to Battlefield Rats — a cooperative medieval scavenger simulator where you and your friends loot fallen warriors, avoid dangers, and try to carry away as much treasure as possible without losing your life, sanity, or each other.

GAMEPLAY

Each nighttime raid is a tense mix of greed, fear, and chaos. Sneak across the battlefield, search knights’ and soldiers’ bodies, stuff your bags with armor, weapons, and coins. But remember: the more you carry, the slower you move, and every sound can attract unwanted attention.

Search fallen warriors for valuable loot, but be careful — not every body is truly dead.

Manage your fear: nervous characters drop items, scream, and can panic at the worst moments.

Avoid dangers: mounted patrols with torches, roaming deserters, packs of wild dogs, and something far worse stalk the field looking for scavengers like you.

Work as a team or betray your friends: share finds, cover each other’s escape, or abandon them to save yourself and your loot.

Return to the village alive: sell your haul, buy gear, feed your characters, and prepare for the next outing on even more dangerous fields.

KEY FEATURES

Co-op for 1-4 players with voice chat — coordinate, joke, or scream in terror together.

Unique characters with different abilities: a swift scout, skilled looter, strong carrier, or cautious observer.

Fear and nerves system: your characters respond to danger, and you’ll have to handle their panic.

Loot physics: items realistically clink, clang, and hamper movement — quietly hauling full armor won’t be easy.

Procedurally generated battlefields with varying dangers, weather, and combat types.

Meta-progression: develop your village, upgrade gear, unlock new fields, and complete special orders.

Unpredictable events: from comical (a crow steals your wallet) to horrifying (what you thought was a corpse suddenly grabs your leg).

WHO IS THIS GAME FOR

Battlefield Rats is made for groups of friends who love cooperative games with elements of horror and dark humor. If you enjoy Lethal Company, Content Warning, or Phasmophobia but want something with a historical setting and unique mechanics — this game is for you.

Get ready to laugh, scream, and betray your friends for a golden chain.

store_data.about_the_game:
CLICK YOURSELF INTO DAMNATION


Soul Clicker is an incremental clicker game about harvesting souls from the
depths of Hell. Start with a single click. End up running an infernal empire
that grinds out souls by the sextillion while you sleep.

Every soul you collect feeds a deeper, darker engine. Every prestige peels
back another layer. There is always a bigger number — and you will chase it.

WHAT YOU'LL DO


  • Click. A lot. Tap to earn souls. Buy buildings. Buy upgrades. Watch
    the numbers climb from 1 → 1,000 → 1 billion → 1 sextillion → and beyond.
  • Build an empire. 31 buildings across three tiers — base, advanced,
    and eternal. Each one produces souls automatically while you do other
    things. Stack them. Multiply them. Worship them.
  • Prestige. Forever. When you've climbed high enough, burn it all
    down for Prestige Points. Spend PP on 53 permanent upgrades across 8
    categories. Come back stronger. Climb faster. Burn it down again.
  • Master four realms. Each advanced building unlocks a minigame:
    • Chaos Engine — spend Chaos Orbs on a tree of building boosts
      and use them to buy Eternal Buildings outright.
    • Abyssal Drill — mine Ancient Fragments and roll for relics
      across five rarities and five effect types.
    • Soul Forge — gamble your souls. Win double or jackpot 10×.
      Lose them all.
    • Lust Labyrinth — hire workers who click for you while
      you're busy clicking for yourself.
  • Equip relics. Roll for randomized rarity-based gear. Stack
    Global CPS, Click power, cost reduction, and auto-clicks. Find the
    legendary All-Seeing Eye and watch every multiplier light up at once.
  • Chase 200+ achievements. Every one you unlock permanently
    boosts your soul production by 1%. By the time you've collected
    them all, idle income is nearly 4× stronger.

FEATURES


  • 31 buildings — from a single Tormented Soul to the Eternal Soul Nexus
  • 500+ building upgrades — each one a meaningful jump
  • 53 prestige upgrades across 8 themed categories
  • 4 fully-fleshed minigames tied to advanced buildings
  • 21 distinct relics across 5 rarities, with bulk inventory management
  • 200+ achievements — each one boosts CPS by 1%
  • 5 random events with massive temporary boosts
  • Custom soundtrack across three moods — pick Main, Lofi, or Metal
  • Independent SFX and BGM volume sliders
  • Save anywhere — local saves, plus export/import for backups
  • No microtransactions. No ads. No timers. No paywalls.

WHO IT'S FOR


If you've ever lost a weekend to Cookie Clicker, Adventure Capitalist, or
Antimatter Dimensions — Soul Clicker is for you. If the words "I'll just
prestige one more time" describe your relationship with games, this is
the abyss you've been looking for.

HOW LONG IS IT


Soul Clicker is endless. The first prestige takes about 30 minutes.
The first hundred prestiges take a couple of weeks. The achievement
hunters might still be playing six months from now.

You can play it actively, leave it running, or both. It rewards every
style.

Click. Build. Damn yourself.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are the child of two things that have always haunted you.

You are about to embark on a journey that even you do not fully understand. From a home filled with cold demands, you will be dragged into another world that promises answers to your every question. But are you truly ready to hear the truth?

In this strange landscape, every step brings you closer to the only thing that matters to you: the truth. You’ll explore an ever-changing reality and encounter mysterious figures, all while searching for the answers hidden behind the final door.

Unique Meta-Horror Features:

  • Identity Recognition: This game utilizes your system information to deliver a personalized horror experience. It knows who is playing.

  • Automatic Closure: To strengthen the narrative impact, the game may close itself automatically at specific points in the story. This is not a crash, but a deliberate part of the experience you must endure.

store_data.about_the_game:
An infinitely expanding 2D Psychological Horror clicker game with hundreds of secrets and puzzles to solve and explore. There is always more to see.

Work through the game's infinitely progressing storyline uncovering the secrets and scares hidden in the deep environmental story-telling.

You are tasked with destroying an ancient artifact all while fending off the entities it attracts and uncovering the meaning behind it all before it's too late.

Beat the game? Great!

With the infinitely expanding storyline in the 'chapter select' structure of the game, you can keep playing with new game mechanics, new lore to uncover, to horrifying monsters to see, and so much more.

Beat all the current content? That's fine.

With the implementation of multiple save files, you are encouraged to replay the game and see all the things you may have missed the first time around.

Important

The Discord server linked on the Steam Store page of the game is where indepth patch notes and development updates will be recorded. Please consider joining if you want to hear about and become a part of the development of the game.

The Discord server is not just a place for the game's community, it is a tool the players can use to enhance their experience while playing. Player's who join the discord have the opportunity to shape the game's future development and become immortalised in the game's credits forever just for making a suggestion.

So i urge you to please join our Discord community if you want to become a apart of something bigger.

This game is made by a solo developer, (me), and I am putting all of my effort and passion into this project, I will listen to every single bit of feedback given both on Steam and in the game's official Discord you can find on the store page.

Be a part of the game's development, let me know what you want to see.

store_data.about_the_game:
《Fluff Up》is a charming yet brutally precise platformer starring a bird who's carrying a few extra ounces. Your

mission: flap, climb, and drag that chunky little body into the sky. It's equal parts delightful and punishing.

GAMEPLAY

The controls couldn't be simpler — hold left or right and your bird flies in that direction. But flying burns stamina

fast, and if you run out before you reach the next cloud, gravity does what gravity does. Plan every move. You're not

exactly aerodynamic.

FEATURES

Easy to learn, hard to stop failing at. This bird is heavy — the physics won't let you forget it. Mid-air turns are

sluggish, stamina is never quite enough, and every flight demands a split-second plan before you commit. There's no

winging it.

Land soft, or fall straight through. Obviously. Clouds are fluffy; your bird is not. Control your descent or you'll

regret it.

Clouds are your friends — most of them, anyway. Every cloud type has its own personality. Learn their patterns, figure

out who helps and who betrays, and you'll climb faster. Or just blame the clouds. Up to you.

A slip isn't the end. If you tumble off a cloud, don't panic — you can still recover. Use whatever's below you to

cushion the fall, scramble for another perch, and claw your way back. Whether you bounce back or plummet to the bottom

depends entirely on your hands.

EXPERIENCE

Cheerful pixel art brings this whimsical world to life, while the tough-as-nails gameplay keeps you coming back for

one more try. The moment you finally break through the highest layer of clouds? Worth every fall.

But success can wait. If you're exhausted, just land on a cloud and rest for a bit. There's no game over here —

falling only means you start climbing again. Take your time. The sky isn't going anywhere.

store_data.about_the_game:
Crowned Games is an online party game platform for groups of 2–12 players.

One host, one lobby, many minigames — play them all in a single session.

YOUR CONTENT, YOUR RULES

Every game that uses player-provided content draws from your own packs.

Build a pack with photos from your friend group, inside jokes as words,

or custom audio clips — the games become personal.

Packs support four asset types:

• Images — use your own photos or downloaded art

• Audio — voice clips, sound effects, music snippets

• Words — custom word lists for drawing or clue games

• Prompts — custom questions and scenarios

📝 QUIZ EDITOR

Build your own trivia rounds from scratch. Write questions, set answer options,

mark the correct one. Import them as a pack and challenge your friends with

questions only they (or only you) would know.

🎮 THE GAMES

IMPOSTOR — Social deduction

Everyone gets the same secret word — except the Impostor. Give clues that prove

you know it without giving it away. Vote out the Impostor before they blend in.

STINKY CROWN — Voting

Each round, a prompt appears. Vote for who in the group fits it best.

The most-voted player earns the Stinky Crown. It stacks.

FRAMEUP — Bluffing

You get an image. Describe it to the group — but you choose whether to describe

yours truthfully or invent a lie about someone else's. The group votes: truth or lie?

MIRAGE — Hint & match

One player writes a hint for their image. Everyone else picks the image from their

own hand that best matches that hint. The group then votes for the original.

Hints that are too obvious or too cryptic lose points — balance is everything.

DOODLE KINGS — Draw & guess

Pick a secret word and draw it. Other players race to type the answer first.

Speed pays more than accuracy — fastest correct guess earns the most points.

QUIZ DUEL — Trivia

A question appears. First to buzz in gets to answer. Right answers earn points,

wrong answers give the lead to someone else. Use your own quiz packs or the defaults.

FEATURES

✓ Multiple minigames in one lobby — mix and match in any order

✓ 2–12 players online

✓ Custom image, audio, word, and prompt packs

✓ Built-in Quiz Editor — write your own trivia rounds

✓ Running score across all games in a session
